strings.(헬레나가 %s의 앞에 놓인 빈 잔에 차를 따라준다.): (Helena refills the empty cup before %s with tea.)
Thank you, Helena. But there's an extra cup.
I said Her Majesty's message would reach you when the time was right, didn't I? That seems to be today.
Before that, explain those ruins in the sky to me.
strings.전부 다 이야기해달라고는 하지 않을게요. 이 사람이 이해할 수 있을 정도: I won't ask you to tell me everything. Just enough for me to understand.
strings.(헬레나에게 마녀에 관한 부분을 빼고 황혼 시절과 신, 그리고 정원에 관: (I tell Helena about the Twilight era, the gods, and the garden, leaving out the parts concerning witches.)
strings.(%s의 이야기를 듣던 헬레나가 알겠다는 듯이 고개를 연이어 끄덕인다.): (As she listens to %s, Helena nods repeatedly in understanding.)
This world truly is full of mysteries. Sigh...
strings.솔직하게 말씀드리자면, 그건 잘 모르겠어요. 지금으로선 당장 문제될 건: To be honest, I don't know. It doesn't seem to pose an immediate problem, but...
strings.(헬레나가 조용히 찻잔을 들어 안에 담긴 차를 한모금 마신다.): (Helena quietly raises her teacup and takes a sip.)
strings.그런데, 아틀라스 정원이 왜 헬레나님께만 보이는 걸까요?: But why can only you see the Atlas Garden?
strings.정확하진 않은 이야기를 하나 하자면…. 실바리아의 피를 받은 아이들에겐: I can't say for certain, but... Children with Silvaria blood have always had special abilities, as though blessed.
strings.암기 능력이 엄청나게 좋다거나 마법사의 소질이 있다거나 정령과 교감을 한: An extraordinary memory, a talent for magic, an affinity with spirits...
strings.능력이라고 하긴 뭐하지만, 이 사람은 가끔 기시감을 느낄 때면 새로운 유: I don't know if one could call mine an ability, but sometimes a feeling of déjà vu would lead me to a new artifact.
strings.고대 시절 신들이 머물렀던 장소의 유적이라 하면 신비한 힘이 있을 테고…: Ruins where gods dwelled in ancient times must hold mysterious power... After handling such artifacts for so long, perhaps some of it affected me.
strings.어쨌든 %s의 설명을 들으니 내 눈에만 보이는 것도 이해가 되는 것 같군: In any case, your explanation helps me understand why only I can see it, %s. If I think of it as ruins and artifacts...
strings.(그 말씀, 언젠가 들은 것 같은데….): (I feel like I've heard something like that before...)
Now, it's time to convey Her Majesty's message...
strings.(헬레나가 다른 빈 잔에 차를 채우기 무섭게 누군가 두 사람 곁으로 다가: (No sooner does Helena fill the other empty cup than someone approaches them.)
Great-Aunt, it's me, Kaina. It's been a while, %s.
strings.(카이나가 헬레나의 품으로 다가가 폭 안긴다. 헬레나가 귀찮다며 떼어내려: (Kaina steps into Helena's arms and embraces her tightly. Helena tries to push her away, protesting, but her grandniece refuses to let go.)
strings.숨막힙니다, 폐하. 정말이지, 쿨럭, 쿨럭. 이 사람을 더는 못 보셔도: You're suffocating me, Your Majesty. Honestly... cough, cough. Would you be content never to see me again?
What a thing to joke about, Great-Aunt.
Great-Aunt, you needn't worry about that.
If Your Majesty says so... Very well.
Then I'll step out for a moment so you two can talk.
strings.아니에요, 할머님. %s, 할머님 집 뒤에서 잠깐 기다려 주시겠어요? 금: No, Great-Aunt. %s, would you wait behind the house? I'll be there shortly.
Of course, Your Majesty. I'll go ahead.
strings.(카이나가 문을 열고 나가는 %s의 뒷모습을 바라본다.): (Kaina watches %s open the door and leave.)
strings.평소와 다른 분위기구나. 보통은 편지를 보내오던 네가 직접 이곳까지 온: You seem different today. You usually send letters. For you to come all this way yourself...
strings.(헬레나가 다가와 카이나를 품에 안고 다독여준다.): (Helena approaches and holds Kaina in a comforting embrace.)
I'm sorry. It's been so long since I saw you, and now I have to leave right away...
It can't be helped. Next time, I'll visit you. I've little else to do. And...
Don't try to bear everything alone...
strings.(조용히 흐르는 강을 지켜보던 붉은 머리 기사가 인기척을 느꼈는지 등을: (A red-haired knight watching the quietly flowing river turns at the sound of footsteps.)
strings.(아르젠트가 조용히 시선을 헬레나의 집으로 옮긴다.): (Argent quietly turns his gaze toward Helena's house.)
strings.폐하께서 헬레나 님과 나눌 말씀이 있는지 제게 여기서 잠깐 기다려달라고: Her Majesty has something to discuss with Helena. She asked me to wait here for a moment.
Understood. Please remain here until she comes.
strings.큰일은 없었습니다. 혹시, 아십니까? 나르샤 말고 커다란 마도 골렘을 다: Nothing major has happened. Do you happen to know a boy who controls an enormous magic golem? Someone other than Narsha...
strings.나르샤라는 아이와 함께 오르카리움이라는 장소에 가셨단 이야기를 들었는데,: I heard you went to a place called Orcarium with Narsha. You must have met him there.
I'm searching for that boy, but his whereabouts have been unclear since he met you, %s. Where could he have gone...?
If you see him again, please let me know.
Her Majesty will be out shortly.
strings.(아르젠트가 서둘러 헬레나의 집 앞쪽으로 뛰어간다. 그리고 집 밖으로 나: (Argent hurries to the front of Helena's house, then escorts Kaina back as she emerges.)
strings.고마워요, 아르젠트. 미안하지만, 잠깐 물러나 주세요. %s에게 전할 이: Thank you, Argent. I'm sorry, but please give us a moment. I have something to tell %s.
strings.(아르젠트가 카이나의 요청대로 이야기가 들리지 않을 정도의 거리만큼 뒤로: (At Kaina's request, Argent steps back far enough to be out of earshot.)
I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
Not at all, Your Majesty. What did you want to tell me...?
strings.아론이 마녀를 찾고 있다고 이야기했었을 거예요. 마녀에게서 뭔가 원하고: I told you Aaron was searching for witches. That he seemed to want something from them.
strings.마녀는 다른 마녀를 죽이게 되면 그 힘을 가지게 되는데, 아론이 그 힘을: When a witch kills another witch, she takes the other's power. Aaron wants that power.
strings.아론은 뭘 하려는 걸까요?: What is he trying to do?
strings.권력이라면 충분하겠지만, 그것보다 더한 걸 원하니까 마녀의 힘이 필요한: He already has ample political power. He must want a witch's power because he seeks something beyond that.
strings.처음엔 제 자리일까도 생각해 봤지만, 그것도 아니었어요. 그 이상의 것을: At first, I wondered if he wanted my throne, but that isn't it. He seems to want something greater still.
strings.보통 사람, 일반적인 인간은 마녀의 능력을 사용할 수 없어요. 그래도 방: An ordinary human cannot use a witch's abilities. But there are ways around that.
strings.특별한 능력이 있는 마녀와 협력하거나 마녀의 능력을 인간이 쓸 수 있게: He would need to cooperate with a witch who has a particular ability, or meet a being with the authority to let a human wield a witch's power.
strings.잠깐만요, 폐하. 그렇다는 건, 예지의 내용이 아론이 마녀를 만나러 간다: Wait, Your Majesty. Does that mean your vision showed Aaron going to meet a witch?
Yes. The time of their meeting is almost here.
strings.미안해요, %s. 이런 걸 말씀드리는 모든 순간이 %s에게 큰 짐이 되는: I'm sorry, %s. Every time I tell you something like this, I feel I'm placing another heavy burden on you, %s...
strings.(카이나가 슬픈 눈빛으로 마을 뒤로 흐르는 아이사르 강의 모습을 바라본다: (Kaina gazes sadly at the Isar River flowing behind the village.)
strings.괜찮아요, 폐하…. 지금 알려주신 정보를 쫓다 보면 이리스에게도 도움이: It's all right, Your Majesty... Following this information should help Iris too.
strings.(지금도 폐하가 어떤 분인지 잘 모르겠어…….): (Even now, I don't really understand what kind of person Her Majesty is...)
strings.원래는 전처럼 편지로 메시지를 드리려고 했지만, 모종의 이유로 %s에게: I intended to send a letter as before, but for some reason, it couldn't reach you, %s.
That's why I came to speak to you myself when you returned from Orcarium.
There's no need to worry too much... Now, I'll tell you when and where.
strings.먼저 여신님을 만나고, 오르카리움으로 가세요. 그러면 언젠가 노네임을 만: First, meet your goddess. Then go to Orcarium. Aaron will appear at the place where you once met No Name.
Only confirm whom he meets and what they discuss, then return.
strings.그 일만 하면 되는 건가요?: Is that all I need to do?
strings.(폐하의 표정이 굳어진 것 같은데….): (Her Majesty's expression seems to have stiffened...)
strings.폐하, 혹시 다음에 더 무슨 일이 일어날지 아시나요?: Your Majesty, do you know what else will happen afterward?
strings.아론은 보통 사람이 아니에요. 그러니까 절대로 들키면 안 돼요. 다른 일: Aaron is no ordinary man. You must not be discovered. We cannot let anything else happen.
Your Majesty, what do you mean by anything else...?
strings.(카이나가 뭔가 이야기를 할 것처럼 입을 열지만, 이내 굳게 다문다.): (Kaina opens her mouth as if to explain, then presses her lips firmly shut.)
strings.%s, 미안해요. 저는 이제 돌아가야 해서…. 확인하는 대로 데이나에게: I'm sorry, %s. I must return now... Tell Dayna what you learn as soon as you've confirmed it.
strings.(카이나가 왠지 모르게 쓸쓸한 미소와 함께 뒤로 물러난다. 그러자 기다리: (Kaina steps back with an inexplicably lonely smile. Argent, who has been waiting, approaches her.)
strings.(카이나의 대답과 함께 아르젠트가 눈이 마주친 %s에게 고개를 끄덕여 인: (At Kaina's reply, Argent meets %s's eyes and nods farewell. Then he points in a direction away from Laran Road.)
strings.(그렇게 카이나와 아르젠트가 사라지고 그들의 뒷모습을 바라보고 있던 %s: (As Kaina and Argent disappear, Helena approaches %s, who is watching them leave.)
Yes, for now. It's about something that hasn't happened yet...
There's no need to worry in advance about what hasn't happened, but...
I still feel uneasy. I'll just have to go and face it.
strings.그래요, %s…. 지금 떠나는 건가요?: I see, %s... Are you leaving now?
I'll pray that all goes well.
Thank you, Helena... I'd better be going.
strings.(이리스에게 가보라고 했으니까 신탁의 방으로 가보자. 그런데 만약 다른: (She told me to see Iris, so I'll head to the Oracle Chamber. But what happens if something else occurs?)
strings.(모험가가 신탁의 방에 들어서자 마자 이리스가 환한 미소로 반긴다.): (The moment the adventurer enters the Oracle Chamber, Iris greets them with a radiant smile.)
Thank you. Levi returned to Jiendia because of you, %s.
strings.그건 어쩔 수 없는 일이었어요. 판도라도 레비가 돌아간 것에 대해선 다행: That couldn't be helped. Pandora will be relieved that Levi went back too.
All right. But there's something I want to ask, Iris.
strings.실바리아 제국의 황제 폐하가 어떻게 예지 능력을 갖추게 됐는지 알아?: Do you know how the empress of Silvaria gained her foresight?
strings.제가 세레스 님의 힘을 받았지만, 힘을 받기 전부터 능력을 갖추고 계셨던: I've inherited Seres's power, but I can't know the past or actions of those who already had abilities before I received it.
strings.그렇다고 해서 이후 일어난 일들도 모두 알고 있는 건 아니에요. 제가 알: That doesn't mean I know everything that happened afterward either. I know only a tiny part of all that happens in the world.
strings.폐하를 만나고 오셨죠? 어떤 말씀을 해주셨나요?: You've just met Her Majesty, haven't you? What did she tell you?
strings.(이리스에게 카이나를 만나 들었던 이야기를 전한다.): (I tell Iris what Kaina said when we met.)
strings.절 만난 후에 오르카리움으로 가보라고 하셨다고요?: She told you to go to Orcarium after meeting me?
I'm worried about her saying nothing else must happen...
Perhaps that means... Though it's only a guess...
strings.실바리아 제국의 황제께선 시간과 공간의 영향을 받고 있어요. 인간인 그분: The empress of Silvaria is affected by time and space. I don't know why that would be true of a human, though.
strings.일단 걱정하지 말고, 오르카리움에 가보세요. 만약에 예정되지 않은 '다른: For now, don't worry. Go to Orcarium. Even if some unplanned "other thing" happens, remember that I'm behind you, %s.
I'll protect you with my power and that of Seres, who ruled over the moon, flowers, and growing things.
Thank you, Iris. I'll be off, then.
And I should have told you this first...
When? Before I went to Luria Village, she was still...
She left as soon as she learned that Daphne had deceived Pandora.
strings.힐다는 자신이 마녀란 이유만으로 많은 사람들이 죽고 다치는 모습을 많이: Hilda has seen many people hurt and killed simply because she is a witch. Unable to bear it, she chose to hide for a very long time.
Then she met you, my adventurer, and her power gradually weakened.
strings.저는 힐다가 떠나지 않기를 바랐지만, 영원히 도망가는 것이 자신의 운명이: I wanted her to stay. But she left, saying her fate was to run forever.
strings.카즈노와 제릴이 하려는 일이 모두에게 예상치 못한 결과를 만들 수도 있다: She said what Kazno and Jeril were planning could bring an outcome none of us expected.
I don't know what she meant. Let's discuss Hilda another time.
All right, Iris. I'll be going. See you later.
strings.(이리스가 떠나는 %s에게 손을 흔든다. %s 또한 그런 이리스의 모습을: (Iris waves goodbye to %s. Watching her in return, %s slowly leaves the Oracle Chamber.)
strings.(이리스가 발걸음을 옮기던 중, 어디선가 날카로운 바람이 불어온다. 그리: (As Iris starts to move, a sharp wind blows in from somewhere. An alien voice, as though not of this world, drifts between its currents.)
strings.(놀란 이리스가 다가오는 바람을 붙잡아 보려고 하지만, 바람은 이리스를: (Startled, Iris tries to catch the approaching wind, but it circles and slips past as though ignoring her.)
You can return. If only you wish to return, I can...
strings.(바람 틈 사이로 흘러나오던 목소리는 바람이 이리스의 작은 손에 붙잡힌: (The moment Iris's small hand catches the wind, the voice within it dissolves into an unearthly wail.)
A being born from my choice now dares to test me...
strings.(모험가의 발걸음이 언젠가 노네임을 만났었던 오르카리움의 구석진 장소에서: (The adventurer stops in the secluded corner of Orcarium where they once met No Name.)
strings.노네임을 만났던 게 얼마 되지 않았는데, 왜 이렇게 오래 지난 거 같지…: It hasn't been long since I met No Name. Why does it feel like ages...?
It's strange that Aaron would come to Orcarium, but according to Her Majesty's vision, he should be here soon...
strings.(모험가가 한적한 곳에 피어있는 짙은 수풀 속으로 들어가 몸을 숨긴다.): (The adventurer conceals themself in thick undergrowth in a quiet spot.)
strings.(시간이 흐르지만, 아론이 나타날 기미가 보이지 않는다.): (Time passes, but there is no sign of Aaron.)
strings.(모험가가 지루함을 이기지 못하고 일어나려던 순간, 멀리 누군가의 목소리: (Just as boredom drives the adventurer to rise, someone's voice sounds in the distance.)
strings.(이런, 들킬 뻔했네. 제대로 숨어있어야지. 저 사람은 아론인가?): (That was close. I'd better stay hidden. Is that Aaron?)
strings.(%s의 시야에 이곳으로 걸어들어오는 두 사람이 보인다. 한 사람은 아론: (Two people walk into %s's view. One is Aaron. The other is a woman whose clothing looks out of place on the Freios continent.)
strings.지엔디아 대륙의 지엔디아 제국에서 먼 걸음 해주신 지엔디아 님…. 일단: Lady Jiendia, who has come so far from the Jiendia Empire on the Jiendia continent... First, thank you for following me here.
strings.마음대로 부르셔도 상관없습니다. 어차피 아론 공을 오래 볼 일은 없을 테: Call me what you like. I don't expect to see you for long in any case, Lord Aaron.
strings.프레이오스 대륙의 태양, 실바리아 제국이 지엔디아 대륙의 엘리아스 왕국과: I know that Silvaria, the sun of Freios, has put great effort into relations with the Kingdom of Elias on Jiendia.
strings.그런데 변방일 뿐인 저희와도 교류를 원한다는 것에 좀 놀랐습니다. 안 그: But I was surprised to hear that you also sought relations with our remote nation. Especially after the trouble we caused...
strings.가짜 아가슈라 남매 건이라면 제국과도 관련된 일이었습니다. 너무 신경 쓰: If you mean the false Agasura siblings, that affair concerned our empire too. You needn't worry excessively.
I never imagined they would reach Eastland, though.
strings.자, 아론 공. 절 제국으로 초청한 사람이 실바리아의 황제 폐하가 아닌: Now, Lord Aaron. I know it was not Silvaria's empress who invited me here. It was you, at the heart of the council...
strings.당신과 비슷한 비열한 웃음을 어디선가 본 것 같은데 기억이 나질 않는군요: I feel I've seen a contemptible smile like yours somewhere before, but I can't recall where.
strings.기억에 남을 만한 일이 아니었나 보죠. 어쨌든 행방불명된 제 신하가 어디: It must not have been worth remembering. In any case, tell me where my missing subject is.
That is why I followed you here.
The inspector was taken by a witch.
strings.(…아론은 다 알고 있어. 그런데 난 언제까지 듣고 있어야 하는 거지?: (...Aaron knows everything. How long should I keep listening? Something feels wrong...)
strings.겨우 그런 말을 하려고 저를 여기까지 오게 한 건가요? 그건 저도 알고: You brought me all this way merely to tell me that? I already know...
And I know that you're working with a witch...
Impressive, for the ruler of another nation to uncover such information.
strings.유능한 감찰사를 신하로 뒀으니까요. 제대로 말씀해 주셔야 아론 공의 신상: I have a capable inspector in my service. You would do well to answer properly, for your own safety... W-wait...
strings.(지엔이 아론을 보고는 뭔가 느꼈는지 뒷걸음친다.): (Sensing something as she looks at Aaron, Jien steps backward.)
This is what I felt when I was captured...
strings.제 신상이 어떻게 되는지 말씀해 주시겠습니까?: Would you care to explain what will happen to my safety?
strings.(아론이 품에서 흉측하게 생긴 단검을 하나 꺼낸다.): (Aaron takes a hideous dagger from his clothing.)
You recognize it. This is what he used to take your time...
strings.(아론이 단검을 만지작거리더니 손가락 끝을 벤다. 그러자 상처 틈에서 피: (Aaron toys with the dagger, then cuts his fingertip. Blood slowly drips from the wound onto the ground.)
strings.(지엔의 발밑으로 붉은색으로 빛나는 마법진이 만들어지고, 떨어진 아론의: (A red magic circle forms beneath Jien's feet, and Aaron's fallen blood begins to boil within it.)
strings.분명 지엔 님은 데미갓과 비슷한 존재…. 그래서 절 상대할 수 있을 거라: You are certainly something akin to a Demigod, Lady Jien... You must have thought you could face me. But you overlooked one thing...
strings.(아무리 예지대로 해야 한다지만, 이대로라면 지엔디아 님이 죽어. 살려야: (I know I'm supposed to follow the vision, but Jien will die at this rate. I have to save her!!)
strings.지엔디아 님!! 이야기는 나중에 하고 여기서 피해야 해요!!: Lady Jiendia!! We can talk later. You need to get away!!
strings.(벌어진 상황을 도저히 그냥 넘어갈 수 없어서 모험가가 움직인 순간, 눈: (Unable to stand by any longer, the adventurer moves. At that instant, everything in sight stops.)
strings.(지엔이 공포에 질려 있고, 아론이 검을 든 채로 멈춰있다. 그야말로 모: (Jien is frozen in terror. Aaron stands still with his blade raised. A world where absolutely everything has stopped.)
strings.(모험가가 팔을 뻗어 지엔디아를 붙잡으려 하지만, 모험가의 손이 멈춰있는: (The adventurer reaches for Jiendia, but their hand passes through her motionless body.)
strings.(그것뿐만 아니라 지엔디아에 닿은 %s의 팔 또한 마치 굳은 것처럼 움직: (Not only that, the arm %s extended toward Jiendia freezes in place as well.)
Wh-what is this? Oh... Is this what she meant by something else happening...?
It's as though time has stopped...
strings.(그렇게 난처해 하고 있던 %s의 앞으로 누군가 천천히 다가온다.): (As %s struggles with the situation, someone slowly approaches.)
strings.(아르케가 손을 뻗어 %s의 왼팔을 붙잡는다.): (Arche reaches out and takes %s's left arm.)
strings.아르케, 여긴 어떻게 왔어요? 프뉴마에서 나오지 못하는 거 아니었어요?: Arche, how did you get here? I thought you couldn't leave Pneuma.
It seems I can enter places that resemble Pneuma.
Adventurer. Get hold of yourself and listen carefully.
strings.카이로스가 잠에서 깨어나지 않고, 크로노스의 시침과 분침이 멈췄어요. 그: Kairos won't wake, and Chronos's hour and minute hands have stopped. And time and space have split in two around you...
strings.일단 눈을 감으세요. 제가 프뉴마로 모시고 갈 테니 제가 뜨라고 할 때까: Close your eyes. I'll take you to Pneuma. Don't open them until I tell you to.
strings.만약 눈을 뜬다면 손을 놓치게 돼요. 손을 놓치면, 모든 걸 되돌릴 기회: If you open your eyes, you'll lose my hand. If that happens, even our chance to put everything right will disappear.
strings.(아르케의 말대로 눈을 감았을 뿐인데, 오른팔이 다시 움직여….): (I only closed my eyes as Arche said, but my right arm can move again...)
Let's go, %s. For now, in the time on your Front Side...
strings.(아르케의 목소리가 조금씩 흐릿해지다가 더는 들려오지 않는다. 마치 시간: (Arche's voice gradually fades until it can no longer be heard, as though time has stopped and sound itself has vanished.)
You may open your eyes now.
strings.(눈을 뜨고 바라본 프뉴마의 모습은 정령이 가득한 세계였지만, 평소와는: (Opening their eyes, the adventurer sees Pneuma full of spirits, yet different from usual.)
strings.(평소라면 힘차게 움직이고 있을 정령들의 움직임이 느리다. 어떤 아에루라: (The spirits, ordinarily so lively, move slowly. Some Aerura hang motionless in midair.)
Shadows from somewhere have engulfed Pneuma.
strings.아니에요. 엘리시아에선 아무것도 하지 않았어요. 프뉴마가 위험해지면 엘리: No. Elysia has done nothing. If Pneuma is endangered, Elysia cannot remain safe either.
strings.지금, 이 상황은 헤카테 님도, 이리스 님도 손댈 수 없어요. 프뉴마 밖: Neither Hecate nor Iris can intervene in this situation. Outside Pneuma, everything is frozen, just as it was before I brought you here.
strings.이리스 님 말씀에 따르면 위대한 벽에 알 수 없는 힘이 개입됐고, 그림자: According to Iris, an unknown power has interfered with the Great Wall. In the form of shadows, it has affected even Pneuma.
strings.모험가님, 침착하세요. 모험가님이 프뉴마 밖을 나가는 순간, 모든 시간이: Calm down, Adventurer. The moment you leave Pneuma, all of time will be thrown into chaos. Even the time you share with Iris...
As though someone were trying to erase the world's time and create a new one...
strings.언젠가 가이아 님께서 말씀해 주셨던 태초 시절 신께서 세계를 만들었을 때: Gaia once told me of the will to create that a god held when shaping the world in the beginning. I can feel it in those shadows.
Returning everything to nothing... Don't tell me...
strings.모험가님, 여기 오기 전 제 말 들으셨죠? 모험가님을 기준으로 시공간이: Adventurer, you heard what I said before we came here, didn't you? Time and space have split in two around you.
More precisely, a Reverse Side of time and space has been created...
strings.제가 이곳에 모셔온 모험가님은 이면. 오르카리움에는 시공간 정면에 있는: The you I brought here is on the Reverse Side. The you on the Front Side remains in Orcarium.
strings.잠깐만요…. 내가 둘이 된 거라고요?: Wait... There are two of me?
strings.거울처럼 생각해보세요. 하지만, 거울과는 조금 달라요. 거울은 비치는 나: Think of a mirror. Though it's a little different. You and your reflection move together in a mirror, but...
strings.정면의 모험가님이 움직이면, 이면의 모험가님이 움직이지 못해요. 반대로: When the you on the Front Side moves, the you on the Reverse Side cannot. And when the you currently on the Reverse Side moves, the Front Side cannot.
Just as you cannot see both faces of a coin at once...
strings.그래도 서로 다른 존재가 된 게 아니기 때문에 양면에서 일어나는 일을 기: Still, you haven't become separate beings. You should be able to remember what happens on both sides.
strings.…다른 시간에, 다른 미래에 내가 존재했던 것처럼요?: ...Like when I existed in another time, another future?
I can't say it's exactly the same, but it's similar.
strings.그런데 아르케는 그걸 어떻게 알고 있어요?: But how do you know all this, Arche?
strings.개인적인 이유로 잠들었다가 깨어나는 과정을 몇 번 보내고, 많은 생명의: For personal reasons, I've passed through sleep and awakening several times. And living in Pneuma, where the times of many lives intersect, I came to understand naturally.
strings.모험가님, 모험가님께서 방법을 찾으셔야 해요. 모험가님과 이리스 님의 시: Adventurer, you must find a way. A way to make your time and Iris's one again...
I'm sorry. This is all the help I can offer...
N-no, Arche... This is all my...
strings.시련이 있던 장소에 이르판 님이 계실 거예요. 창조의 의지가 태어난 장소: Irfan will be at the trial grounds. He will open a door to the place where that will to create was born.
strings.(아르케가 환하게 웃으며 %s의 두 손을 꼭 잡는다.): (Arche smiles brightly and clasps both of %s's hands.)
Thank you, Arche. I'll set things right and come back.
strings.(아르케가 엘리시아로 가는 문으로 향하는 모험가를 배웅한다.): (Arche sees the adventurer off toward the door to Elysia.)
You'll be able to return, Adventurer...
strings.프뉴마의 관리자에게서 이야기를 들었겠지?: You've heard from Pneuma's caretaker, I assume?
And you know this is not Lady Hecate's doing...
At a time like this, is that really...
strings.에트와르의 이면으로 갈 수 있는 문을 연 건 자네를 위해서가 아닐세. 엘: The door to Etoile's Reverse Side was not opened for your sake. It was for Elysia.
For that misguided will to reach toward Pneuma, a divine realm...
strings.이리스 님께서 자의든 아니든 신의 영역으로 넘어가실 때 만들어진 것이 지: What was born when Iris crossed into the realm of the gods, willingly or otherwise, has now grown this powerful.
strings.이리스 님을 원망하는 게 아닌, 이리스 님이 섣불리 나설 수 없는 상황이: I am not blaming Iris. Merely explaining that she cannot act carelessly in this situation... Understand that.
strings.자네가 가서 해결할 수밖에 없어. 이리스 님의 사람이라면 그릇된 의지를: You have to go and resolve it. As Iris's mortal, you may be able to meet that misguided will and put an end to this.
strings.에트와르가 그릇된 의지에 삼켜져 다른 모습이 되는 건 원하진 않을 테니…: You surely don't wish Etoile to be swallowed by it and remade into something else...
Head down beneath the Trial of the Black Moon. You'll see.
strings.(이르판이 대지의 시련 밑으로 내려가는 모험가의 뒷모습을 바라본다.): (Irfan watches the adventurer descend beneath the Trial of the Earth.)
The true serpent has revealed itself, beyond a mere shadow...
strings.(이르판이 알려준 곳에 발을 내딛는 순간, 회색빛 엘리시아의 풍경이 온통: (The moment the adventurer steps into the place Irfan indicated, Elysia's gray scenery begins to warp.)
strings.(한 걸음 한 걸음 나아갈수록 일그러진 풍경은 다가오는 어둠에 잠기는 것: (With every step, the distorted scenery fades further, as though swallowed by approaching darkness.)
It's dark everywhere, like the road to Pneuma. Oh, a light over there...
strings.(빛이 보이는 쪽에 나가는 길이 있는 거겠지? 일단 가보자…. 뭐지, 이: (The light should lead to a way out. Let's go... What is this nostalgic feeling...?)
strings.(빛을 따라 걷던 %s의 앞으로 어둠이 지워지면서 새로운 장소가 나타난다: (Following the light, %s watches the darkness clear to reveal a new place. An unparalleled desolation brings their steps to a halt.)
strings.(마을인 것 같은 장소에 무슨 일이 일어났는지 보이는 건물들이 파괴되거나: (Whatever happened to this town, its buildings are destroyed or reduced to ugly remnants.)
strings.(새로운 장소를 탐색하기 위해 나아가려는 순간, 모험가의 목 뒤로 금속의: (Just as the adventurer moves to explore, cold, sharp metal touches the back of their neck.)
Walk straight to the wall. Now...
strings.(검의 주인인 것 같은 여성의 낮은 목소리가 들려온다.): (A woman's low voice sounds, apparently belonging to the sword's wielder.)
Do as I say. Answer only what I ask. Nod if you understand.
strings.(일단 하라는 대로 하고, 상황을 봐서 벗어나자.): (I'll cooperate for now and look for a chance to get free.)
strings.(모험가가 고개를 끄덕이자 검이 살짝 뒤로 빠진다.): (When the adventurer nods, the sword draws back slightly.)
Tell me who you are and where you came from.
strings.(여성이 %s의 이름을 듣고 놀랐는지 되묻는다.): (Startled by %s's name, the woman asks again.)
strings.네, 저는 %s…, 에트와르라는 곳에서 제가 처한 상황을 해결하기 위해서: Yes, %s... I came from a place called Etoile to resolve what's happened to me.
I'll lower my sword. Turn around and look at me, %s...
strings.(여성의 목소리가 한결 부드러워지는 걸 느낀 모험가가 조심스레 등을 돌린: (Hearing the woman's voice soften, the adventurer cautiously turns.)
strings.(엘리아스 전통 복식처럼 보이는 옷차림의 여성과 눈이 마주친다.): (Their eyes meet those of a woman dressed in what looks like traditional Elias clothing.)
strings.(굳은 표정이었던 여성의 얼굴에서 조금씩 미소가 피어오른다.): (A smile gradually replaces the woman's stern expression.)
strings.(뭐지, 이 기시감은…? 분명 처음 보는 사람인데, 낯설지가 않아….): (What is this déjà vu...? I've never seen her before, yet she feels familiar...)
strings.(여성의 눈가에 조금씩 눈물이 맺히기 시작한다. 갑자기 우는 여성의 모습: (Tears begin to gather in the woman's eyes. Her sudden weeping leaves %s bewildered.)
strings.괜찮으세요? 왜 그러세요?: Are you all right? What's wrong?
strings.(우는 여성을 보고 있던 %s의 눈에서 갑자기 눈물이 흐른다.): (Watching the woman cry, %s suddenly begins shedding tears as well.)
strings.(여성이 다가와 눈물을 닦아준다. 모험가가 놀라 뒤로 물러나지만 여성이: (The woman approaches and wipes away the tears. The adventurer startles and steps back, but she extends a reassuring hand.)
strings.이해해. 분명 이상할 거야. 처음 보는 것 같은 사람에게서 익숙한 느낌이: I understand. It must feel strange. Someone who seems like a stranger feels familiar to you.
strings.그걸 어떻게…. 혹시 당신도 신인가요?: How did you know...? Are you a god too?
I'm no god. Just an ordinary person.
strings.신이 아니라면서 마치 제 생각을 읽은 것처럼 말하고 있잖아요. 우리 본: You say that, but you speak as though you've read my mind. We've met before, haven't we?
strings.맞아…. 너는 나를 본 적이 있어. 기억하고 있었구나. 영영 기억하지 못: Yes... You've seen me before. You remembered. I thought you'd never remember again...
strings.어떤 너는 나를 원래 알고 있었을 거야. 어떤 너는 나를 잠깐 우연으로: Some versions of you would have known me all along. Others would remember me as someone they briefly met by chance.
strings.지금 내 앞에 있는 네가 내 기억 속 사람이 아닐 수도 있어…. 그래도: The you standing before me may not be the person in my memories... Still, you came here of your own will. And you've met me as I am now.
And I want you to remember. Please don't forget. My name is Ellie...
strings.(여성이 자신의 이름을 밝힌 순간, 갑자기 %s의 머릿속이 흔들리기 시작: (The moment the woman reveals her name, %s's mind begins to reel. A flood of memories pours in.)
strings.(루미너스란 이름을 말한 순간, 갑자기 주위가 어두워진다.): (The instant the name Luminous is spoken, the surroundings darken.)
strings.(엘리가 서둘러 %s의 두 손을 잡는다. 그러자 %s의 시야를 가득채웠던: (Ellie quickly takes both of %s's hands. The darkness filling %s's vision disappears.)
strings.억지로 기억할 필요 없어. 너는 지금의 너 그 자체로 훌륭하고 충분한 존: You don't have to force yourself to remember. The person you are now is wonderful, and more than enough...
strings.(저 사람을 보니까 안정되는 기분이야. 왜 그러지….): (Looking at her makes me feel calm. Why...?)
There's nothing for you to do here in [Vigrid] right now.
I'll make a path. Return to where you came from.
strings.(모험가가 엘리에게 상황을 설명하려는 순간, 갑자기 땅이 흔들린다.): (Just as the adventurer begins explaining to Ellie, the ground suddenly shakes.)
strings.(땅이 흔들리면서 방금 전까지도 보이지 않던 다른 세계의 존재들이 나타나: (As the earth trembles, beings from other worlds appear where none stood before and approach them.)
strings.어디서 계속 나타나는 거지?: Where do they keep coming from?
You don't seem willing to turn back...
If there's no helping it, I won't coldly order you home.
Let's rest here. It won't be long, but we can catch our breath.
strings.(엘리가 쫓아오는 다른 세계의 존재를 쓰러뜨리고 주위를 둘러본다.): (Ellie defeats a pursuing creature from another world and surveys the area.)
strings.엘리, 여기가 비그리드라고 했죠?: Ellie, you said this place is Vigrid?
strings.내게서 이야기를 듣고 싶다면 먼저 네 이야기를 해줘. 난 아직 네게서 대: If you want my story, tell me yours first. You haven't answered me yet.
strings.(엘리에게 비그리드에 온 이유를 짤막하게 이야기한다.): (I briefly explain to Ellie why I came to Vigrid.)
From a world turned to its Reverse Side, you would naturally reach another Reverse Side.
This is Vigrid. The Reverse Side of a place called Luminous City.
strings.루미너스 시티는 고통스럽고 아프고 슬픈 감정들이 없길 바라는 한 사람의: Luminous City was born from one person's wish for a world without suffering, pain, or sorrow.
strings.오래전에는 위그드라실이라는 이름이었지. 이리스가 성계신이 되기 전 잠들었: Long ago, it was called Yggdrasil. It was the place Iris dreamed of while she slept, before becoming God of the Astral Realm.
strings.자, 잠깐만요. 나무밖에 없었던 위그드라실이 지금 이렇게 됐다고요?: W-wait. Yggdrasil was nothing but a tree. You're saying it became all this?
strings.이해하기 복잡할 거야. 오딘과 니이는 너를 아주 오래전 머나먼 과거에 만: It's difficult to understand. Odin and Nii met you in the distant past, long ago. But for you, that was only a few years ago...
strings.오딘은 니이와 함께 위그드라실 위에 이리스가 꿈꾸는 감정이 가득한 마을을: Together with Nii, Odin built a town upon Yggdrasil, filled with the feelings Iris dreamed of.
strings.처음엔 아무도 없던 마을이었지만, 다른 세계에서 사람들이 이주해 정착했고: At first, it was empty. Then people from other worlds migrated and settled here. Children were born, and the streets filled with life.
I wanted to tell you more... But now doesn't seem to be the time.
There are more beings from other worlds than before.
Where are they appearing from? We haven't found a gate...
In any case, we'll have to deal with them again...
strings.고마워. 하다만 이야기는 돌아와서 마저 할까?: Thank you. Shall we finish our conversation when we return?
It was nothing. Please continue where you left off.
strings.다른 세계에서 온 사람들과 새로 태어난 아이들로 마을이 활기가 가득했다고: The town was full of life, with people from other worlds and children born here.
strings.그렇게 사람들이 가득 찬 마을의 모습이 환한 빛처럼 느껴져서 니이가 루미: The bustling town seemed to shine with a brilliant light, so Nii named it Luminous.
strings.오딘과 니이는 위그드라실의 끝을 보고 싶지 않았지. 영원을 바라면서 계속: Odin and Nii never wanted Yggdrasil to end. They wished for it to last forever.
But the weaknesses of an incomplete, unstable world will always reveal themselves.
strings.루미너스가 그렇고, 에트와르가 그래. 파멸의 운명을 바라는 자들이 계속해: It's true of Luminous, and of Etoile. Those who desire a fate of destruction keep threatening them...
strings.에트와르에 마계의 문이 연결됐던 때처럼 이곳도 언젠가 그렇게 된 적이 있: Just as a gate to the Demon Realm once opened in Etoile, something similar happened here. More than once...
strings.우리는 할 수 있는 일을 해야 했어. 사랑하는 마을에 살고 있는 모든 생: We had to do what we could. We sought a way to protect every life in the town we loved.
strings.사람들이 알아차리지 못하게 세계를 반으로 가르고. 루미너스와는 다른 공간: Without the people's knowledge, we split the world in two and made a space separate from Luminous. Though both are still within Yggdrasil...
Then we drew the World Tree's roots into that space and planted them there.
strings.루미너스와는 같지만, 다른 장소. 이면이 만들어진 거야. 오직 이면에서만: A place the same as Luminous, yet different. We created a Reverse Side, so outside threats could arrive only there...
strings.다른 세계에서 이곳을 원하는 자들이 들어와도 루미너스의 이면인 이곳에서: Even if invaders from other worlds entered, they would be unable to leave this place, Luminous's Reverse Side.
And so this became [Vigrid], the battlefield where we resist outside invasion.
That's why there are no people, and the buildings are ruined...
strings.세계의 멸망을 바라는 자들이 계속해서 여러 세계들을 연결시키려 해. 그러: Those who want the worlds to end keep trying to connect them. The more they do, the more the Great Wall shakes...
strings.어느 정도 거리를 유지하던 루미너스가 에트와르에게 점점 가까워진 것도 그: That's also why Luminous, which had kept some distance, gradually drew closer to Etoile.
strings.오딘에게서 여길 자기 힘으로 날려버렸다는 데미갓 이야기를 들었어. 그건: Odin told me of a Demigod who claimed to have blown this place away with their own power. That's impossible.
If it could have ended so easily, none of us would have suffered...
I don't want to lose this place, where the people I cherish live...
There's someone who wants to see you...
strings.(두 사람이 사람들의 보금자리였던 것 같은 작은 집의 마당을 거쳐 새로운: (The pair passes through the yard of a small house that once seems to have been someone's home, arriving at a new place.)
strings.(파괴된 회색 건물 잔해 뒤로 파란색으로 빛나는 잎을 지닌 나무 한 그루: (Behind the ruins of a gray building stands a single tree with glowing blue leaves.)
strings.(%s의 도착을 반기는 것처럼 불어오는 바람에 파란 잎이 흔들린다.): (A breeze stirs the blue leaves as though welcoming %s.)
strings.세계수의 기운이 느껴지는 것 같지 않아?: Can't you feel the World Tree's presence?
strings.(엘리가 파란 나무 레라드에게 다가가 줄기를 쓰다듬는다.): (Ellie approaches the blue tree, Lerad, and strokes its trunk.)
Thank you for holding on today too.
(A woman with long, shimmering hair slowly emerges from behind Lerad.)
strings.(니이가 모험가 곁으로 다가가 두 팔로 살며시 안아준다.): (Nii approaches the adventurer and gently embraces them.)
strings.많은 시간과 흔들리는 공간, 다가갈 수 없던 차원을 넘어서 이렇게 널 다: Across so much time, shifting space, and dimensions we couldn't reach... To see you again makes me happy.
strings.어떤 너에겐 짧은 시간일수도, 어떤 너에겐 길고 긴 시간일 수도 있지만,: For some versions of you, it may have been a short time. For others, a very long one. But we've met again...
You're saying the same things as Ellie.
strings.후후, 그래? 어쩔 수 없어. 누구보다 특별한 너라서 그런 말을 할 수: Hehe, am I? I can't help it. I can say them because you're more special than anyone.
You keep saying that. It's a little embarrassing...
Hehe. That's enough greetings. Look at Lerad, %s.
strings.(사람보다 키가 조금 큰 나무가 강인한 느낌으로 자리를 굳게 지키고 있다: (The tree, a little taller than a person, stands firmly with an air of strength.)
strings.레라드는 그리 크지 않지만, 힘있게 하늘을 향해 뻗어있어. 비그리드의 중: Lerad isn't large, but it reaches powerfully toward the sky. Standing at Vigrid's heart, it supports Luminous.
strings.레라드가 꺾이면 루미너스는 그대로 붕괴하고 말아. 최악의 상황이 된다면: If Lerad breaks, Luminous will collapse. In the worst case, you, I, and this little world we love could be reduced to rubble.
Then we would scatter into space and fall onto Etoile.
strings.반은 맞고, 반은 아니야. 우로보로스는 모든 게 사라지길 바랄 뿐, 파괴: Half right, half wrong. Ouroboros wants everything to disappear, but it doesn't desire destruction.
strings.지금 비그리드가 파괴되고 있는 건 우로보로스의 의지가 절대자의 뜻과 만난: Vigrid is being destroyed because Ouroboros's will has encountered the will of the Absolute.
strings.우로보로스는 카드인 채로 발견돼야 했지만, 다양한 시간의 다양한 장소에서: Ouroboros should have been found as a card. Instead, it roams through many places and times.
strings.여기저기 자기 흔적을 만들었을 거야. 아마 너도 만난 적이 있을 거라 생: It must have left traces everywhere. I imagine you've encountered them too.
strings.그런데, 그 많은 걸 어떻게 알고 계시죠?: But how do you know so much?
Have you forgotten? I'm Luminous City's guardian.
strings.한때는 세계수를 파괴할 운명을 지닌 용이었지만…. 네 덕분에 그런 운명을: I was once a dragon fated to destroy the World Tree... But thanks to you, I overcame that fate and am here now. That's why Odin and I are always grateful to you, %s.
So don't feel burdened. Finish what you need to do and return to your own time.
strings.고마워요, 니이. 오딘에게도 인사를 하고 싶은데, 어디에 있죠?: Thank you, Nii. I'd like to greet Odin too. Where is he?
strings.오딘은 다른 세계의 문이 있을만한 장소를 찾으러 갔어. 찾게 되면 바로: He went to search for places where gates to other worlds might appear. Once he finds and deals with them, he'll return to Lerad.
He should be back by now...
strings.(니이가 뭔가 알아차렸는지 모험가와 엘리에게 물러나라는 손짓을 한다.): (Sensing something, Nii gestures for the adventurer and Ellie to stand back.)
strings.(곧이어 니이의 발밑에서 검은 안개가 피어나 레라드가 있는 공간을 가득: (Black mist rises beneath Nii's feet, filling the space around Lerad. A dragon with gleaming black scales emerges from within.)
strings.(검은 용이 다가오는 외부의 적을 향해 뭔가 소리쳤지만, 적들은 멈추지: (The black dragon cries out at the approaching invaders, but they continue forward.)
strings.(결국 적들은 경고를 무시한 대가로 검은 용의 숨결로 재가 되어버린다.): (Having ignored the warning, the enemies are reduced to ash by the black dragon's breath.)
strings.(검은 용의 주위로 다시 안개가 피어오른다. 검은 안개가 검은 용을 삼키: (Mist rises around the dragon once more, swallows it, and slowly fades, leaving Nii standing in its place.)
I'm sorry, Nii. I didn't think they'd follow us.
strings.(안개 사이에서 원래의 모습으로 돌아온 니이가 천천히 다가온다.): (Restored to her usual form, Nii slowly approaches through the mist.)
strings.괜찮아, 엘리. 그들이 엘리를 따라온 게 아냐. 본능적으로 여기에 끌린: It's all right, Ellie. They weren't following you. They were drawn here by instinct.
strings.(니이가 하늘을 바라보자 마자 비그리드의 모든 것이 흔들리기 시작한다.): (The instant Nii looks up, everything in Vigrid begins to shake.)
strings.비그리드에 다른 세계의 문이 도착한 것 같아…. 오딘이 찾지 못한 장소에: A gate from another world seems to have arrived in Vigrid... Did it land somewhere Odin couldn't find?
strings.(니이가 뭔가 느꼈는지 주위를 두리번거리며 불안해한다. 그걸 본 엘리가: (Sensing something, Nii looks around anxiously. Ellie approaches and takes both her hands.)
Nii, it's all right. Don't be afraid.
strings.…하나도 아니고 여러 기운이 느껴져서 조금 놀랐을 뿐이야. 죽음과 불인: ...I was just surprised to sense several presences, rather than one. Death and fire, I think... In any case...
strings.(침착해진 니이가 조심스레 모험가를 바라본다.): (Having calmed herself, Nii looks carefully at the adventurer.)
strings.어쩌면 지금 네가 해야 할 일이 일어났는지도 몰라. 비그리드와 연결되려는: Perhaps the task you came for has finally appeared. Finding the gates trying to connect to Vigrid...
Thank you, %s... Take care of Ellie.
%s, remember the path we just took? Let's go back and see what's happening.
I thought we'd defeated every invader in Vigrid...
strings.(엘리가 멀리서 비그리드를 헤매는 외부 존재들을 바라보며 쓸쓸해한다. ): (Ellie looks sadly at the otherworldly beings wandering Vigrid in the distance.)
(Where Ellie points stands a structure that feels unlike the rest of Vigrid.)
So that's a gate to another world...
strings.저쪽엔 짙은 안개가 껴있고, 다른 한쪽에선 용암이 흘러나오고 있어. 지금: Thick fog pours from one, and lava from the other. Two gates have never appeared at the same time before...
Usually, one disappears before another arrives.
strings.저 문들은 네가 오기 전까지 보이지 않았었어. 그런데 네가 오고 나서 한: Those gates weren't visible before you came. They seem to have appeared together after your arrival...
As though they were waiting for me...
strings.지금까지 나타난 적들은 레라드를 비롯해 비그리드의 모든 걸 갉아먹거나 파: Until now, the invaders tried to consume or destroy everything in Vigrid, including Lerad.
strings.그런데 저기 있는 몇몇 존재들은 그런 건 상관없는 것 같아. 이곳이 어떤: But some of those creatures don't seem interested in that. They're examining this place. As though gathering information...
We need to investigate the gates...
strings.엘리는 여기서 레라드 쪽이 위험하지 않게 적들을 막아주세요. 제가 가서: Ellie, please hold off the enemies here and keep Lerad safe. I'll investigate.
Having you here makes me feel a little more at ease.
Oh, someone's over there. Is that...?
In front of the gate with the fog? Oh, it's Odin.
strings.(엘리의 말대로 가까운 곳에 늑대같이 고독한 분위기를 지닌 남성이 문을: (As Ellie said, a man with the lonely air of a wolf stands nearby, gazing at the gate.)
strings.여기는 나에게 맡겨. 그리고 조금이라도 이상한 일이 생기면 이곳으로 돌아: Leave this to me. If anything seems even slightly wrong, come back here.
Don't worry too much, Ellie. I'll be back.
strings.(열차가 지나다니는 역의 입구처럼 생긴 커다란 구조물이 덩그러니 비그리드: (An enormous structure resembling the entrance to a railway station stands alone within Vigrid.)
strings.(그 앞에서 신비한 분위기의 오드아이를 지닌 한 남자가 고개를 들어 구조: (In front of it, a man with mysterious mismatched eyes looks up at the sign attached to the structure.)
strings.(오딘이 다가오는 %s의 목소리를 듣고 고개를 돌린다.): (Odin turns at the sound of %s's approaching voice.)
strings.(오딘과 마주한 순간, %s의 머릿속에 다양한 그의 모습이 떠오른다.): (Facing Odin, %s recalls many different versions of him.)
strings.(자신감이 넘치는 하얀 세계의 주신, 냉정한 모습으로 발할라 학원을 살펴: (The confident chief god of the white world, and the chairman coldly overseeing Valhalla Academy.)
I'm sorry, %s... I should have made sure you never had to come to Vigrid...
strings.어떻게 네가 여기까지 오게 됐는지 알고 있어. 시간의 뒤틀림이 널 이곳으: I know how you came here. The distortion of time must have guided you...
strings.이 세계의 주신인 내가 더 강했다면 운명을 넘어 네게 그런 일이 일어나지: If I were stronger as this world's chief god, I could have defied fate and kept this from happening to you...
It's all right, Odin. You're already doing so much to protect Vigrid. Don't blame yourself.
I came here to do what I need to do, too...
strings.이리스가 널 믿고 의지한 이유를 의심한 건 아니었지만, 지금 제대로 알겠: I never doubted Iris's reasons for trusting and relying on you, but now I truly understand. You've grown so much stronger and more resilient, %s...
strings.이 방법이 네 시간과 비그리드를 온전하게 만들 방법일지는 모르겠어. 그래: I don't know if this will restore both your time and Vigrid. Still, we have to try.
strings.이 문 너머의 세계는 지금까지 내가 상대했던 세계와는 달라. 그래서 다른: The world beyond this gate is different from those I've faced before. We need another approach.
strings.문 너머에서 우리를 기다리고 있는 자가 있다. 그 세계의 주인인 자, 그: Someone is waiting for us beyond it. That world's ruler. They don't want their world connected to Vigrid either.
strings.위그드라실과 레라드의 존재를 알고 있는 세계의 주인이라면 자연스레 알고: Any ruler who knows of Yggdrasil and Lerad understands it naturally.
strings.「…위그드라실의 힘에 끌려 닿는 세계가 모두 모이면 그들만의 전쟁이 일어: 「...When all the worlds drawn by Yggdrasil's power gather, war shall erupt among them. And thus shall come Ragnarok.」
Come, %s. First, to [Niflheim], the world of death...
strings.(오딘이 천천히 니플헤임이라 불리는 세계 안으로 가기 위해 발걸음을 옮긴: (Odin slowly approaches the entrance to the world called Niflheim.)
strings.(안에서 흘러나오던 죽음의 안개는 더욱 짙어져 조금씩 비그리드에 있던 오: (The mist of death pouring from within thickens, gradually obscuring his form in Vigrid.)
strings.니플헤임…. 왠지 모르게 낯설지 않은 느낌이 드는데. 어떤 곳이지?: Niflheim... Somehow, it feels familiar. What sort of place is it?
strings.(모험가 또한 오딘을 따라 안개를 헤치고 들어가고, 멀리서 이곳을 바라보: (The adventurer follows Odin through the mist. A small figure watching from afar approaches the gate.)
strings.설마 니플헤임의 문도 여기에 닿은 거야?: Has even Niflheim's gate reached this place?
This is bad... I need to tell Surtr...
strings.(안개가 자욱한 세계에 발을 내딛는 순간, 한 번도 느껴본 적 없는 느낌: (The moment they step into the fog-shrouded world, a chill unlike anything they have felt before envelops them.)
Niflheim's cold only feels like this at first. You'll soon grow used to it. But...
This isn't the Niflheim I know.
strings.니플헤임이 여러 곳이라도 되는 건가요?: Is there more than one Niflheim?
There is only one World Tree, but countless worlds that know of it...
strings.그런 세계는 서로 닿아선 안 돼. 닿는 순간, 힘을 가진 세계만 살아남고: Those worlds must never touch. When they do, only the powerful survive. The rest are fated to disappear.
strings.그게 바로 라그나로크…. 세계수를 중심으로 살아남기 위한 그들만의 전쟁…: That is Ragnarok... Their war for survival around the World Tree. And the battlefield of that war is Vigrid...
strings.이런 세계들은 서로 자신의 세계를 유지하기 위해 많은 힘을 썼어. 나의: These worlds have devoted great power to preserving themselves. Just as mine has struggled to avoid colliding with Etoile.
strings.(오딘이 주위를 둘러보며 주위를 확인하던 중, 안쪽의 짙은 안개 사이에서: (As Odin surveys the surroundings, a woman's silhouette moves within the thick mist.)
strings.(모험가가 무기를 들어 경계하자 오딘이 팔을 뻗어 가로막는다. 잠시 후,: (The adventurer raises their weapon warily, but Odin extends an arm to stop them. The figure emerges from the mist and stands before them.)
strings.(검은 세계에서 유일한 빛인 것 같은 보랏빛을 감싸안은 여성이 또각또각: (A woman wrapped in violet light, seemingly the only light in this black world, approaches with clicking footsteps.)
strings.(여유있는 모습으로 팔짱을 낀 헬이 오딘과 모험가를 응시한다.): (Hel folds her arms and studies Odin and the adventurer with calm assurance.)
strings.나도, 니플헤임도 당신들이 알고 있는 사람과 존재가 아닌가보군요. 역시: Neither I nor this Niflheim seems to be the one you know. And you aren't the Odin who sent me here...
strings.거기 모험가. 내가 당신을 직접 본 건 아니예요. 니플헤임에 떨어진 시공: Adventurer, I haven't met you in person. I saw you in a vision while hunting a space-time worm that fell into Niflheim.
When another me was caught by that worm...
In any case, enough introductions. Tell me why you've come.
We must destroy this place. More precisely...
strings.말 그대로다. 니플헤임의 주인이여, 너도 라그나로크가 일어나는 걸 원치: Exactly as I said. Ruler of Niflheim, surely you don't want Ragnarok to occur.
strings.기쁨의 날을 기다리며! 손님을 맞이하기 위해 만들었던 장소예요. 그런 곳: I built this place to welcome guests, waiting for a day of joy! And you ask me to destroy it? Uninvited intruders, no less...?
strings.여길 엉망으로 만들 수는 없어요. 여기는…, 여기는!!: I won't let you ruin it. This place... This place!!
strings.비그리드에 다른 문이 하나둘씩 더 생기면 니플헤임이 무너지는 것은 순식간: If more gates appear in Vigrid, Niflheim will collapse in an instant, Hel.
The ruler of Niflheim knows full well that there isn't.
strings.(헬이 눈을 감고 있다가 뜬 순간, 붉은 눈동자가 빛나기 시작한다.): (Hel closes her eyes. When she opens them, her red gaze begins to glow.)
strings.(헬이 한 손을 들어 안대를 여는 순간, 뒤에 있던 검은 안개가 튀어올라: (Hel raises a hand and lifts her eyepatch. Black mist surges from behind her and races toward Odin and the adventurer.)
strings.(검은 안개는 두 사람을 속박하듯 묶어버리더니 들어왔던 통로를 향해 날려: (The mist binds them, then hurls them toward the passage they entered through.)
strings.이 세계에 가득한 내 힘을 막을 수 조차 없는 당신들의 요구를 받아줄 수: I cannot accept the demands of people who cannot even resist my power in this world...
strings.(흩어진 검은 안개가 다시 모이고 그 사이로 날아가 버린 줄 알았던 존재: (The scattered black mist gathers again. From within it, one figure who should have been thrown outside slowly emerges.)
strings.(헬이 놀란 표정으로 다가오려는 자의 모습을 바라본다.): (Hel looks in surprise at the approaching figure.)
I thought I had to hold on, and the mist dispersed. Oh, Odin...
Only Odin was thrown out, while you remained? I can hardly believe it.
strings.여기 있는 당신을 환상 속의 당신으로 착각했어요. 사과하죠. 그때의 당신: I mistook you for the person in my vision. I apologize. You must be very different from that version of yourself...
strings.(헬이 뭔가를 골똘히 생각하다가 조용히 등을 돌린다.): (After a moment's deep thought, Hel quietly turns away.)
strings.그러면 당신의 이야기를 들어드리죠. 당신이 이곳에 온 이유를 알아야겠어요: Then I will hear your story. I need to know why you've come. Only then can I understand. But not here.
I'll wait by the road to Niflheim City.
strings.당신의 의지가 강하다면 거기서 기다리고 있을 나를 다시 만날 수 있을 거: If your will is strong, you will find me waiting there.
strings.(손을 뻗어 헬을 붙잡으려 하지만, 헬은 자신의 할 말만 남긴 채 제자리: (The adventurer reaches for her, but Hel vanishes from the spot, leaving only her words.)
strings.(게다가 멀리서 니플헤임의 주민으로 보이는 존재들이 침입한 외부자를 잡으: (Meanwhile, figures that appear to be Niflheim's residents rush toward the intruder from afar.)
Sigh. So this is how she'll test my resolve... No choice, then.
Wait for me, Hel. I'll come and tell you everything...
strings.(니플헤임 스테이션의 다른 구역으로 넘어갈 때마다 살을 에는 듯한 차가운: (Each new section of Niflheim Station brings another blast of bitter, cutting wind.)
strings.(그렇게 한참을 지나 도착한 니플헤임 스테이션의 끝, 밖으로 나갈 수 있: (After a long journey, the adventurer reaches the far end of the station. A passage leading outside slowly comes into view.)
strings.여기가 헬이 말했던 길이겠지?: This must be the road Hel mentioned.
Huh? The air above is cold, but the ground keeps getting warmer...
strings.(허리를 숙이고 바닥에 손을 대고 있던 %s의 시야로 또각또각 소리를 내: (As %s bends to touch the ground, Hel's boots come into view, clicking toward them.)
strings.말 그대로에요. 이곳은 점점 뜨거워지고 있어요. 무스펠헤임으로 가는 문이: Exactly what I said. This place is growing hotter. Because a gate to Muspelheim is nearby, I suppose.
strings.자, 여기까지 무사히 날 만나러 왔으니 당신의 이야기를 해봐요. 들어줄게: Now, you've reached me safely. Tell me your story. I'll listen.
strings.(헬에게 비그리드에 오게 된 이야기를 간단하게 한다.): (I briefly tell Hel how I came to Vigrid.)
...I see. So you have your own reasons...
strings.(헬이 %s의 이야기를 듣고 니플헤임 스테이션 밖으로 보이는 강을 조용히: (Hearing %s's story, Hel quietly gazes at the river beyond Niflheim Station.)
strings.상처입은 신이 추방당해 떨어진 곳은 얼음과 얼음에서 흘러나오는 냉기밖에: The place where a wounded god fell after exile held nothing but ice and the cold flowing from it. There was no sign of life.
strings.신이 해야 할 일은 별 다른 게 없어요. 어떤 장소에서도 생명을 보살펴야: A god's duty is simple. To care for life, wherever they may be.
strings.다른 세계에서 이곳을 죽음이라고 해도, 지옥의 시작이라고 해도 상관없었죠: It didn't matter if other worlds called this place death, or the beginning of hell.
Those who came here sought only to escape the depths of despair.
strings.그래서 신은 냉기를 이겨낸 그들을 위로하고, 함께 니플헤임을 일으켰어요…: So the god comforted those who endured the cold, and together they built Niflheim... Ah...
But if the heat keeps rising... this world will vanish.
strings.이야기 속 신은 헬, 당신이겠죠?: That god in your story is you, Hel, isn't it?
strings.그래요. 이곳의 주인인 내 이야기. 난 이제 결정해야 해요. 날 일으킨: Yes. The story of this world's ruler. Now I must decide, before even the will that raised me melts away...
This place was made for a day of joy yet to come.
strings.%s, 내가 날 포기하고 니플헤임을 지킬 수 있게 해줘요. 그게 당신과: %s, let me give up myself to protect Niflheim. If that is how I can protect you and Vigrid...
strings.(헬이 자신을 바라보는 모험가를 보며 가볍게 미소짓는다.): (Hel gives the adventurer a faint smile.)
strings.(헬의 미소가 사라질 때쯤 니플헤임 스테이션이 흔들리기 시작한다. 그리고: (As Hel's smile fades, Niflheim Station begins to shake. The cold world fills with the mist of death rising around her.)
strings.(혼신을 다한 모험가의 일격이 죽음의 안개를 뿌리치고 헬에게 날아간다.): (The adventurer strikes with all their strength, breaking through the mist of death to reach Hel.)
strings.(멀리 날아간 헬이 다시 한번 일어나지만, 힘이 들어가지 않는지 그대로: (Thrown far away, Hel rises once more, but her strength fails and she collapses.)
strings.당신은 왜 내게 손을 내미는 거죠?: Why are you offering me your hand?
strings.(헬이 바닥에 쓰러진 채로 자신을 향해 내민 %s의 손을 바라본다.): (Lying on the ground, Hel looks at %s's outstretched hand.)
...I don't think fighting like this serves any purpose.
I can't. Not for a reason like this...
strings.내가 본 환상 속에서도 당신은 날 죽이지 않았죠. 날 죽일 수 있던 기회: You didn't kill me in the vision I saw either. Even though you had the chance...
strings.(헬이 %s의 손을 붙잡고 일어난다. 그리고 뒤로 물러나 등을 돌린다.): (Hel takes %s's hand and stands, then steps back and turns away.)
strings.그렇다면 어쩔 수 없군요. 당신이 날 죽이지 않겠다면, 나라도 날 죽여야: Then there's no helping it. If you won't kill me, I'll have to kill myself...
strings.(헬의 말과 함께 니플헤임 스테이션 바깥으로 흐르던 강이 움직임을 멈춘다: (At Hel's words, the river outside Niflheim Station stops flowing. Water surges upward, engulfs her, and freezes her solid.)
strings.(헬의 주위에 피어오르던 죽음의 안개가 다가오려는 모험가를 밀어낸다. 이: (The mist of death around Hel pushes the approaching adventurer away. Then it splits, parts of it turning into sharp thorns.)
strings.(송곳으로 변한 안개는 바다의 세찬 파도처럼 솟아올라 헬에게 파고든다.): (The mist, transformed into spikes, rises like fierce ocean waves and pierces Hel.)
strings.(놀란 모험가가 서둘러 쓰러지는 헬에게 다가간다. 그러자 헬을 감싸고 있: (The horrified adventurer rushes to the falling Hel. All the mist of death and cold surrounding her flows down into the ground.)
strings.(방금 전까지 바닥에서 느껴졌던 온기가 어느샌가 사라지고, 다시 냉기가: (The warmth beneath the ground vanishes, and cold returns.)
strings.(정신을 잃었던 헬이 언제 깨어났는지 미소를 짓는다.): (Hel, unconscious a moment before, opens her eyes and smiles.)
strings.대체 무슨 짓을 한 거죠?: What on earth did you do?
Aaaah! Y-you startled me! Don't do that so suddenly...
strings.(헬이 %s에게 다가와 볼에 키스하고 반응을 살핀다.): (Hel approaches %s, kisses their cheek, and watches their reaction.)
Why so surprised? Aren't you used to this sort of thing?
How could I be used to someone I thought was dead waking up?
strings.(모험가가 놀라 어쩔 줄 몰라하며 뒷걸음질 치자 헬이 환하게 웃는다.): (The adventurer backs away in flustered surprise, and Hel smiles brightly.)
Thank you, %s... for breaking the empty resolve I clung to...
strings.니플헤임에 오랫동안 있으면서 나는 그날만을 기다렸어요. 절대 그날이 오지: Throughout my long years in Niflheim, I waited for that day. Even though I knew it would never come...
strings.소중한 존재를 다시 만나는 날, 나 혼자 기쁨의 날로 정하고 멋대로 기다: The day I would meet someone precious again. I declared it my day of joy and waited, all on my own.
strings.어리석다는 걸 알고 있었어요. 오랜 시간이 흘러 머릿속도 얼어버린 건지…: I knew it was foolish. Perhaps all those years had frozen my mind too... I think I needed something to break that spell.
Perhaps I should be grateful that I cast it off, even like this...
But are you all right? You really... died...
Hehe. So that's what worried you.
strings.니플헤임에 있는 나에게 죽음은 무한한 것…. 새로운 깨달음을 얻기 위한: For me, here in Niflheim, death is endless... Merely a means of reaching a new understanding.
Don't be disappointed, %s. You've earned my trust.
strings.…이대로 돌아가 오딘에게 이걸 건네주세요. 그리고 알려주세요. 세계수를: ...Return and give this to Odin. Tell him I will not let that empty twilight, Ragnarok, unfold around the World Tree.
You may be the first person to enter the world of death and thank me. Hehe.
strings.(얼굴에서 미소를 거둔 헬이 인사를 마치자마자 냉기가 가득 실린 죽음의: (Hel's smile fades. As she finishes her farewell, the cold-laden mist of death rises again.)
strings.자, 돌아가서 비그리드와 닿으려는 무스펠헤임의 문을 찾아요. 그리고 나중: Now, return and find the gate from Muspelheim trying to reach Vigrid. Until we meet again.
strings.(죽음의 안개가 걷히자 안에 있던 헬의 모습은 온데간데없다.): (When the mist clears, Hel is nowhere to be seen.)
strings.무스펠헤임? 아, 늦었네…. 이제 돌아가도 되겠지?: Muspelheim? Oh, too late... I suppose I can go back now.
strings.(방금 전까지도 차갑게만 느껴졌던 니플헤임 스테이션에서 다른 느낌이 다가: (Something different reaches the adventurer from Niflheim Station, which until now had felt only cold.)
strings.일단 밖으로 나가서 엘리와 오딘에게 이야기하자. 그리고 무스펠헤임의 문으: I'll go outside and tell Ellie and Odin. Then we'll head to Muspelheim's gate...
strings.(비그리드를 찾아온 외부 존재를 상대하고 잠시 쉬고 있던 엘리의 발밑이: (While Ellie rests briefly after fighting Vigrid's invaders, the ground beneath her suddenly shakes.)
strings.(오딘이 나타나 엘리의 뒤를 공격하려는 좀비의 목을 붙잡는다.): (Odin appears and seizes a zombie by the neck as it attacks Ellie from behind.)
strings.이 자들은 니플헤임에서 이곳을 정찰하기 위해 나온 좀비들이지. 강글라티라: These zombies came from Niflheim to scout this place. Ganglati, I believe they're called.
strings.이들은 비그리드로 나온 순간, 이성을 잃었다. 그리고 외부의 힘에 의해: The moment they entered Vigrid, they lost their reason. An outside power eroded their minds as well...
strings.이젠 죽음에서 삶을 갈구하고, 생명력을 흡수하려는 한낱 괴물이 될 뿐이야: Now they're mere monsters, craving life from within death and seeking to drain it from others...
strings.(오딘의 손에서 흘러나온 푸른 불꽃이 붙잡은 좀비의 몸을 감싼다. 잠시: (Blue flames flow from Odin's hand and engulf the captive zombie. They climb its body and reduce it to ash.)
My apologies to Hel, but there is no other way...
strings.오딘, 고마워요. 그런데 안으로 들어간 거 아니었나요?: Thank you, Odin. But didn't you go inside?
strings.다른 세계라 그런지 몰라도 내 뜻으로 할 수 있는 게 없었다. 그래도 이: Perhaps because it was another world, there was little I could do. Still, Iris's adventurer seems to have persuaded Hel and resolved matters...
strings.방금 일어난 흔들림이 니플헤임과 이곳을 연결하던 통로가 사라지고 있다는: That tremor proves the passage linking Niflheim to this place is disappearing.
I see. Then there's only one left, Odin.
strings.(니플헤임 스테이션 입구가 있던 장소에서 모험가가 나와 오딘과 엘리에게로: (The adventurer emerges from where Niflheim Station's entrance stood and approaches Odin and Ellie.)
strings.(안도하는 엘리 옆에 있던 오딘이 다가와 %s의 상태를 확인한다.): (Beside the relieved Ellie, Odin approaches and checks %s's condition.)
I sense Niflheim's power strongly. If you've brought something back, show me.
Hel asked me to give you something. Here...
To entrust me with part of her own life force...
strings.이곳의 운명을 함께 하겠다는 건가요?: Does that mean she'll share this place's fate?
It's the best choice in our present situation...
strings.그렇군요. 그런데, 오딘…. 다 떠나서 이 상황을 모두가 원하는 방향으: I see. But, Odin... Setting everything else aside, how can we bring this to the ending everyone wants?
Only by keeping the one who desires destruction from tampering with Etoile.
strings.그의 의지를 멈출 수 없는 지금 상황에서 우리가 할 수 있는 건 더 강해: We cannot stop his will as we are now. All we can do is grow stronger.
strings.결국 그의 의지를 흔들 수 있을 정도는 되어야 한다는 거군요…. 가혹하네: So we need to become strong enough to shake his resolve... That's harsh.
strings.걱정만 하다가는 끝이 없겠어요. 자, 오딘. 다음 장소로 가요. 무스펠헤: We could worry forever. Come on, Odin. Let's go to the next place. Muspelheim's gate...
The lava flowing from Muspelheim's gate is no ordinary lava.
Only a little has seeped through, but if the barrier breaks, it will flood out. Enough to engulf all of Vigrid...
Ragnarok begins when Surtr's fire burns Vigrid.
strings.수르트는 무스펠헤임과 불의 주인…. 태어나자마자 모든 걸 태울 운명을 품: Surtr rules Muspelheim and its flames... A being born with the fate of burning everything.
strings.수르트도 자신의 불이 다른 영역을 태우는 걸 원하지 않기에 고민하고 있을: She doesn't want his fire to burn other realms either, so she must be struggling with this. But we have no way to enter from here...
strings.(고민하고 있던 오딘과 %s의 앞으로 갑자기 다른 세계의 존재가 다가온다: (A being from another world suddenly approaches Odin and %s as they deliberate.)
Stop there, unless you want to be destroyed.
strings.어차피 이건 환영이야. 네가 소멸시킨다고 해도 다른 환영이 너희들을 찾아: This is only an illusion. Destroy it, and another will come to you. So listen.
You there. I sense Muspelheim's fire in you. Are you...?
strings.나는 신마라, 수르트의 가족이라고 하면 될까?: I'm Sinmara. You could call me Surtr's family.
strings.(신마라의 환영이 이름을 밝히고 오딘과 엘리, 그리고 %s의 주위를 맴돈: (After introducing herself, Sinmara's illusion circles Odin, Ellie, and %s.)
strings.용암이 비그리드를 덮기도 전에 그림자 늑대가 위대한 벽을 뚫고 내게 달려: Before the lava even covers Vigrid, a shadow wolf will break through the Great Wall, fall upon me, and swallow me.
strings.오딘? 그 이야기는 뭐죠?: Odin? What are you talking about?
The Bride of Heaven shall purify the world, and all sin shall vanish...
strings.(저 말, 어디서 들어본 것 같은데, 어디서 들어봤지? 아….): (I've heard that somewhere. Where was it? Oh...)
strings.우리는 원하지 않지만, 세계수와 엮인 세계의 미래가 계시록 [에다]에 기: Though we do not wish it, the future of the worlds bound to the World Tree is written in the book of prophecy, [Edda]. A terrible account of worlds and their rulers burning away.
I've heard there's a girl somewhere with a similar name. Never mind that.
strings.그래서 이 땅의 주신께서 함부로 움직이면 안 돼. 그러니까 대신할 사람을: That's why this realm's chief god mustn't act recklessly. Send someone in your place. Someone who can withstand Surtr's fire...
strings.오딘, 저 여자는 안 돼. 평범한 인간은 무스펠헤임에 발을 내딛자 마자: Odin, not that woman. An ordinary human will turn to ash the moment they step into Muspelheim.
Ellie, I understand your resolve, but this is beyond what you can endure.
I understand. It's frustrating, but there's no helping it...
strings.(신마라의 환영이 %s 앞으로 다가와 눈을 맞춘다.): (Sinmara's illusion approaches %s and meets their eyes.)
You're the one who returned after speaking to Niflheim's ruler, right? Hmm, let's see. You really aren't an ordinary human.
A human blessed by a god amid twisted, distorted time...
strings.내가 널 무스펠스 터널 안으로 밀어 넣으면 살 수는 있을 거야. 그래도: If I pushed you into Muspels Tunnel, you'd survive. But you wouldn't escape serious burns.
strings.너 생각보다 생각이 짧구나. 이건 그렇게 쉬운 게 아냐. 모두를 죽게 만: You're more reckless than I thought. This isn't that simple. Are you trying to get everyone killed?
strings.신마라, 무스펠헤임에 흐르는 불을 이겨낼 수 있는 방법만 찾으면 되는 건: Sinmara, do we only need a way to withstand the fire flowing through Muspelheim?
Ellie, stay here and deal with those corrupted after emerging from the gates.
strings.(오딘이 신마라의 환영과 모험가를 데리고 니이가 있는 레라드 앞으로 간다: (Odin leads Sinmara's illusion and the adventurer to Lerad, where Nii waits.)
As you know, the gates from Niflheim and Muspelheim...
strings.(니이가 오딘이 하려는 이야기를 듣지도 않고, 두 손을 뻗어 그의 허리를: (Without waiting to hear him out, Nii reaches out with both hands and catches him around the waist.)
strings.내가 레라드를 열심히 지키고 있는데, 이렇게 자리 오래 비워도 되는 거야: I'm working so hard to protect Lerad, and you leave me alone for this long? Hm? Do you know how long I've waited?
It took a little longer than expected. I'm sorry.
I'm generous, so I'll gladly forgive you.
strings.(언젠가 이런 광경을 본 것 같은데…. 아, 왜 맘에 안 들지?): (I feel like I've seen this before... Ah, why does it annoy me?)
You two look lovely together. Or should I say, god and dragon?
Where did this cute little one come from? Don't tell me she's fallen for Odin...
strings.그런 거 아니거든요. 저는 아저씨 취향 아니라서 괜찮아요. 당신이 계속: Nothing like that. Older men aren't my type. You can keep him.
Nii, there's something I need to tell you.
strings.내게 뭔가 부탁하려는 거지?: You want to ask me for something, don't you?
You rarely make that face. Tell me, Odin.
strings.(오딘과 신마라의 환영이 니이에게 현재 상황과 불을 이겨낼 힘이 필요하다: (Odin and Sinmara's illusion explain the situation to Nii and their need for power to withstand the fire.)
strings.(니이가 살며시 웃으며 머리를 넘긴다. 그리고 오딘의 손을 붙잡아 목에: (Nii smiles softly and sweeps her hair aside. Taking Odin's hand, she places it against her neck.)
Will you be all right doing it here? Even if it's my request...
strings.오딘, 난 언제나 괜찮아. 곁에 당신이 있잖아. 우리에게 중요한 일을 떠: Odin, I'm always all right. You're beside me. Remember what matters to us.
strings.(오딘이 니이를 바라보다 고개를 푹 숙인다. 그리고 니이의 뜻을 받아들여: (Odin looks at her, then bows his head. Accepting her wishes, he lifts the hand resting against her neck.)
strings.(니이가 고통스러운 듯 눈을 질끈 감는다. 잠시 후, 니이의 목이 살짝: (Nii squeezes her eyes shut in pain. A small split opens in her neck, and a black fragment resembling cold, hard metal rises from it.)
strings.칠흑보다 짙고 어두운 검은 용의 비늘…. 저걸 손에 쥐고 들어간다면 무스: A black dragon's scale, darker than the deepest night... Hold that in your hand, and even Muspelheim's lava will feel cool.
strings.(오딘이 비늘을 손에 쥐자, 힘겹게 버티던 니이가 그대로 주저앉는다. 깜: (As Odin takes the scale, Nii's strength gives out and she slumps down. Startled, he catches her and helps her sit before Lerad.)
Don't look like that. See? The wound has already healed.
strings.(니이가 아무렇지도 않다는 표정으로 자기 목을 가리킨다.): (Nii points to her neck with a reassuring expression.)
I never wanted to cause you such pain.
strings.세계수의 포식자였던 날 곁에 머물게 해준 것만으로도, 이미 당신은 나의: I was the World Tree's devourer, yet you let me stay beside you. That alone made you my world. My everything...
I'll dream for a little while. Stay beside me.
strings.(오딘이 고개를 끄덕이자 니이가 눈을 감은 채로 잠에 빠져든다. 잠들어도: (Odin nods, and Nii closes her eyes and falls asleep. Even in sleep, her hand remains wrapped around his.)
strings.이거 받아. 신마라의 환영이 말했던 것처럼 손에 쥐고 무스펠헤임에 들어가: Take this. As Sinmara's illusion said, hold it in your hand when you enter Muspelheim.
strings.(검은 용의 비늘에서 신비한 힘이 느껴져…): (I can feel a mysterious power in the black dragon's scale...)
strings.저기 오딘, 니이는 괜찮은 건가요?: Odin, will Nii be all right?
After a few hours' sleep, she'll be fine.
strings.오딘, 저 용은 당신을 많이 신뢰하고 있네?: Odin, that dragon trusts you deeply, doesn't she?
I don't think Surtr's feelings toward you are any different.
Anyway, Odin... Wish this one success. Let's go, %s.
I'm counting on you, %s... When you return, come to where Ellie is, not here.
Understood, Odin. Please take good care of Nii.
If Hel trusts you, you'll find some way to talk to Surtr too...
strings.무스펠스 터널 문은 저쪽이야. 보이지?: Muspels Tunnel's gate is over there. See it?
strings.그런데 너 아까부터 자꾸 반말이야?: By the way, why have you been talking to me so casually?
strings.내가 반말했어? 아, 그랬네. 너도 반말해서 왠지 그렇게 해야 할 것 같: Have I? Oh, I suppose I have. You were speaking casually too, so it felt natural.
strings.그런 건 신경 쓰지 마. 일단 가자고. 지금 내가 무스펠헤임에 들어가는게: Never mind that. Let's go. Getting me into Muspelheim is what matters right now.
strings.뭔가 당한 기분인데…. %s, 같이 가. 내 손을 잡고 들어가야 열기가: I feel like I've been had... %s, wait for me. It'll be less hot if you hold my hand going in. Hey! I said wait!
strings.(툴툴대는 신마라의 환영을 달래주며 도착한 문 앞에 서자 닫혀있던 문이: (After soothing the grumbling illusion of Sinmara, the adventurer reaches the gate. It opens, and a blast of heat seizes them and draws them inside.)
Don't be dramatic. You have the black dragon's scale. You'll manage.
strings.(뜨거운 열기가 사라져 앞을 바라보자 어딘가로 향하는 길이 끝도 없이 펼: (As the initial heat passes, an endless road stretches ahead. Below it, blazing lava flows toward somewhere unseen.)
The lava flows like a river...
strings.우리는 보이는 그대로 불의 강이라고 불러. 이 강은 우리 세계를 이루는: We call it the River of Fire, just as it looks. It sustains our world, but to other worlds, it is death itself.
strings.그래서 우리는 이 강을 관리하기 위해 위에 터널을 만들고 덮었어. 그리고: So we built a tunnel over it to contain and manage it. We cool the river, purify it into ordinary water, then release it outside.
strings.무스펠헤임에 흐르는 용암은 세계수가 있는 땅을 덮치게 되어 있거든. 그러: Muspelheim's lava is fated to engulf the land of the World Tree. But if it flows out as an ordinary river, there's no problem.
strings.강의 열기를 식게 했다면, 멈추게 할 수는 없는 거야? 그러면 이게 비그: If you can cool the river, couldn't you stop it? Then it wouldn't flow into Vigrid.
strings.……잠깐, 너 지금 뭐라고 했어? 분명 강을 멈추고 싶다고 이야기 한거야: ...Wait. What did you just say? Did you say you wanted to stop the river?
strings.(그때 멀리서 커다란 검을 끈 채로 다가오는 여성의 모습이 %s의 시야에: (A woman dragging an enormous sword approaches from the distance, entering %s's view.)
strings.(신마라의 환영이 일어날 일을 막으려 앞으로 나오지만, 불타는 검 끝에서: (Sinmara's illusion moves forward to intervene, but flames have already exploded from the burning blade toward the adventurer.)
strings.(미처 공격을 피하지 못한 모험가가 그대로 벽까지 날아가 버린다.): (Unable to dodge in time, the adventurer is hurled against a wall.)
strings.(모험가의 목에 한기와 열기가 뒤섞인 날카로운 검의 끝이 다가온다.): (A sharp sword tip, radiating both heat and cold, approaches the adventurer's neck.)
Raise your head, traveler from another world.
strings.(검붉은색의 짧은 의상부터 머리에 달린 검붉은 뿔까지, 마치 타오르는 불: (From her short dark-red clothing to the dark-red horns on her head, the expressionless woman seems like flame itself.)
I am Surtr, ruler of Muspelheim. State your name.
strings.(수르트가 %s의 이름을 듣고 눈을 감는다.): (Surtr closes her eyes upon hearing %s's name.)
strings.수르트, 검을 거둬. 이 사람이 불의 강을 멈춘다고 이야기한 건 몰라서: Surtr, lower your sword. This person spoke of stopping the River of Fire because they didn't understand.
strings.(수르트가 신마라의 환영에게 조용히 하라는 시늉을 한다.): (Surtr gestures for Sinmara's illusion to be quiet.)
strings.%s, 그대가 이름을 거짓으로 고한 건 아니겠지?: %s, you haven't given me a false name, have you?
strings.그래, %s. 다시 한번, 무스펠헤임의 주인으로서 묻겠다. 이 밑으로: Very well, %s. As Muspelheim's ruler, I ask again. Do you truly not know what it means for the River of Fire below us to stop?
I really don't. I want to understand why you reacted that way...
strings.말해주지. 불의 강을 멈추겠다는 건 이 세계의 주인인 나를 죽이겠다는 것: Then I'll tell you. To stop the River of Fire is to kill me, the ruler of this world...
strings.(%s의 목에서 수르트의 검이 거둬졌다고 생각한 순간, 다른 손에서 커다: (Just as Surtr's sword withdraws from %s's neck, an enormous flame awakens and dances in her other hand.)
That does not mean your ignorance is forgiven, %s...
(The flame rising from Surtr's hand plunges into %s's chest.)
strings.신마라, 난 내가 할 수 있는 걸 할 뿐이야. 무스펠헤임의 미래를 위해서: Sinmara, I'm only doing what I can. For Muspelheim's future...
strings.수, 수르트…. 내, 내게 무슨 짓을 한 거죠?: S-Surtr... What have you done to me?
strings.(수르트가 쓰러지지 않기 위해 겨우 버티고 있는 모험가의 모습을 바라본다: (Surtr watches the adventurer struggle to remain standing.)
The black dragon's scale kept you from turning to ash. You're enduring it well.
strings.그대에겐 시간이 없다. 때가 되면 그대 안에 스며든 불꽃이 폭죽처럼 터질: You have little time. When the moment comes, the fire within you will burst like fireworks.
strings.내게 왜 이러는 거죠?: Why are you doing this to me?
strings.(수르트가 대답 대신 등을 돌리자 신마라의 환영이 난처한 표정으로 뒤를: (Instead of answering, Surtr turns away. Sinmara's illusion follows, looking troubled.)
strings.이 터널의 끝에 무스펠헤임 시가지로 나가는 통로가 있다. 그 앞에서 기다: At the end of this tunnel is a passage into Muspelheim's city. I'll wait there.
strings.오는 동안, 그대를 적으로 인식하는 다른 세계의 존재부터 신마라가 만든: On the way, you'll have to face beings from other worlds that regard you as an enemy, and every illusion Sinmara has made.
When you reach me, defeat me with your own will.
strings.(수르트가 자신의 말을 끝내자마자 아래쪽으로 흐르던 불의 강으로 뛰어들어: (Finishing her words, Surtr leaps into the River of Fire below and disappears.)
Sigh. I knew this would be difficult, but I didn't expect this...
strings.(그런데, 기분이 이상한 걸…. 내 안에 한기와 열기가 한꺼번에 들어와: (But something feels strange... As though heat and cold have both entered my body...)
Stop overthinking. I'll go... and make her talk properly.
strings.(끝이 보이지 않는 무스펠스 터널에서 위협적인 존재들이 모두 모험가의 손: (Throughout the seemingly endless Muspels Tunnel, threatening beings fall at the adventurer's hands and vanish.)
strings.신마라의 환영은 그렇다 쳐도 나머지는 무스펠헤임에 있는 존재가 아닌 것: Sinmara's illusions aside, the others don't seem to belong to Muspelheim at all.
strings.(게다가 한발 한발 내디딜 때마다 무스펠스 터널 안에서 느껴지는 열기가: (With each step, the heat within Muspels Tunnel grows stronger.)
According to Sinmara, the river should be cooling as it flows...
strings.(주위를 살피며 앞으로 걸어가고 있던 %s의 앞에 터널의 끝인 것 같은: (As %s advances and surveys the surroundings, an enormous gate appears at what seems to be the tunnel's end.)
strings.(앞으로 다가가자 문이 열리며 그 안에서 수르트의 모습이 나타난다. 수르: (Approaching it, the adventurer sees the gate open and Surtr emerge. The moment her eyes meet %s's, she swings her sword.)
Surtr, I have something to tell you.
There's no time. Defeat me first. Then speak.
strings.(%s의 말에 다음 공격을 이어가려던 수르트의 움직임이 멈춘다.): (At %s's words, Surtr stops before launching her next attack.)
strings.그게 아니라면 대체 뭐죠? 무스펠헤임을 이루는 불의 강이 수르트, 당신: Then what is it? If the River of Fire that makes up Muspelheim is you yourself, Surtr...
The fire inside me is growing hotter.
When I awoke in the darkness and opened my eyes, I was given a purpose.
The rulers of worlds connected to the World Tree must fulfill their purpose...
Unlike other rulers, mine cannot be one of light and hope.
strings.내가 사랑하는 무스펠헤임의 불로 모든 세계의 존재들을 녹아내리게 만드는: To melt every being in every world with the flames of my beloved Muspelheim.
strings.그래서 오랫동안 사명을 지키지 않기 위해, 운명에 따르지 않기 위해 발악: For so long, I've struggled to avoid fulfilling that purpose. To defy my fate...
It seems today is the day.
strings.(수르트가 검을 아래로 휘두르는 순간, 수르트의 붉은 눈동자를 비롯해 주: (As Surtr swings her sword downward, everything around her blazes, including her red eyes.)
strings.(엄청난 열기야. 이대로라면 대화하는 건 불가능하겠지….): (Such tremendous heat. There's no chance of talking like this...)
strings.운명을 확인하고 싶다면 먼저 무스펠헤임에서 깨어난 불꽃 아래서 발버둥 치: If you wish to witness fate, first struggle beneath the flames awakened in Muspelheim...
strings.(수르트의 말이 끝나고, 터널 아래서 요동치고 있던 용암이 솟구쳐 거센: (As Surtr finishes speaking, the churning lava below the tunnel rises and surges toward them like a furious wave.)
strings.(한바탕 거센 파도 같던 용암이 몰아치고 나서야 두 사람의 움직임이 멈춘: (Only after the raging wave of lava sweeps through do the two come to a halt.)
strings.(이번엔 제, 제대로 막아야 해….): (This time, I have to block it properly...)
strings.(다시 한번 두 사람의 공격이 서로 부딪혀 커다란 폭발을 일으킨다. 그: (Their attacks collide once more in a tremendous explosion. The impact hurls the adventurer away and onto the ground.)
%s, just as you act for your world, I act for mine...
strings.(수르트가 천천히 %s에게 다가가려고 하는 순간, 무스펠스 터널이 흔들리: (As Surtr slowly approaches %s, Muspels Tunnel begins to shake.)
strings.(심한 현기증을 유발하고, 아무것도 보이지 않는 상황. 뭐라도 붙잡으려: (Severe vertigo strikes, and the adventurer can see nothing. They reach for something to hold, but find only empty air.)
So dizzy... C-cold... and hot... Ugh... uhhh...
strings.(…아, 살 것 같아……. 어지러움도 이제 없어….): (...Ah, that's better... The dizziness is gone...)
strings.(추운 것도 사라지고, 뜨거운 것도 사라졌어…. 따뜻해….): (The cold is gone, and so is the heat... It's warm...)
strings.%s, 정신 차려. 일어나, 일어나라고!!: %s, snap out of it. Wake up! I said wake up!!
strings.언제까지 수르트 무릎에 누워있을 거냐고?!: How long are you going to lie in Surtr's lap?!
strings.(%s의 주위를 가로막았던 어둠이 흩어지면서 조금씩 투박한 터널의 모습이: (The darkness surrounding %s disperses. The rough tunnel gradually comes into view, along with the River of Fire flowing beneath it.)
strings.(그리고 자신을 바라보는 수르트와 신마라의 환영과 눈이 마주친다.): (The adventurer meets the eyes of Surtr and Sinmara's illusion, both watching them.)
strings.(모험가가 놀라 뒷걸음질 치자 수르트가 아무렇지도 않은 듯 옷에 묻은 용: (Startled, the adventurer scrambles backward. Surtr rises calmly, brushing lava from her clothing.)
No, I'm sorry. But, Surtr... Where are we standing...?
In the middle of the River of Fire's path.
strings.몇 시간 전, 새로운 세계가 비그리드와 연결되려는 것이 차단되면서 무스펠: A few hours ago, another world was prevented from connecting to Vigrid. The shock reached even Muspelheim.
You were exhausted, and the tremor made you lose consciousness and fall into the River of Fire's path.
Surtr was startled and pulled you out of the River of Fire.
Even with a black dragon's scale, no living thing should endure that heat. Ordinarily, you would have melted away... But you...
Fell into it and survived unharmed.
strings.(모험가가 주위를 두리번거린다. 불의 강 얕은 곳에 수르트와 함께 서 있: (The adventurer looks around. They are standing with Surtr in a shallow part of the River of Fire.)
strings.호, 혹시 수르트가 제 가슴에 심어놓은 불꽃, 그것 때문인가요?: C-could it be the flame you put in my chest?
strings.그 불꽃은 네가 날 쓰러뜨리면 자연스레 사라지는 것이었다. 그러면 신마라: That flame would have disappeared naturally if you defeated me. Then Sinmara would have become Muspelheim's ruler in my place...
Surtr, don't say that! That isn't what I wanted.
strings.(수르트가 쪼그려 앉아 불의 강에 조용히 손을 집어넣는다.): (Surtr crouches and quietly places her hand in the River of Fire.)
strings.이계의 여행자가 불의 강에 빠진 순간, 강의 열기가 식었어. 내 안에 있: The moment the otherworldly traveler fell into the river, it cooled. The heat inside me faded as well...
At this rate, we can send purified water to other worlds too.
How did that happen? The river cooling...
Across time and space, you have received many blessings.
strings.세계수의 수호자, 포식하는 검은 용의 비늘, 죽음의 기운을 밀어내는 보랏: The World Tree's guardian, the devouring black dragon's scale, violet mist that repels death, the power of earth that brings flowers into bloom, and the will of a girl who dreams of happiness...
strings.%s, 그대는 누구지? 누구인데, 이렇게까지 사랑받는 거지?: %s, who are you? Who could be loved this much?
strings.저는 평범한 모험가에요. 다른 건 없어요. 할 일을 하다보니 그렇게 됐을: I'm an ordinary adventurer. Nothing more. I just did what I needed to do, and this is where it led.
(After gazing at the flowing River of Fire, Surtr rises and extends her hand. Sinmara's illusion drifts over and settles on it.)
strings.일단 끝났어. 내 운명의 흐름이 잠시 멈추긴 했지만 끝이야. 그리고 %s: For now, yes. The course of my fate has only paused, but it's over. And %s...
When you fell into the River of Fire, a memory flowed into my mind...
strings.네가 온 세계의 이름이 에트와르인가?: Is the world you came from called Etoile?
That star is calling other worlds to it, against its ruler's will...
strings.(분명 위험한 내용의 기억인데, 이상하게 안도감이 느껴져…. 이리스가 약: (That's clearly a dangerous revelation, yet I feel strangely relieved... It isn't because Iris is weak, or because she did something wrong...)
...I'm sorry. It was only a fleeting, uncertain memory...
And when you return, give this to Odin.
strings.(수르트가 품에서 뭔가를 꺼내 %s에게 건네준다. 무표정한 수르트의 얼굴: (Surtr takes something from her clothing and hands it to %s. It is a small badge with a rough drawing of her expressionless face.)
Thank you, Surtr. See you again.
I hope we don't meet again. It would hardly be for a happy reason.
Goodbye, %s. Thank you. The exit is over there.
Oh, there it is. I'll be going, then.
strings.(신마라의 환영이 떠나는 %s의 뒷모습을 향해 손을 흔들고, 그 모습을: (Sinmara's illusion waves after the departing %s while Surtr watches.)
Surtr, let's go home and rest. You haven't had a single peaceful day in so long...
strings.왜 그래? 수르트? 기분 안 좋아?: What is it, Surtr? Are you upset?
No. Not upset. Something feels strange...
You know it too, Sinmara. Ymir's world was... long ago...
strings.(레라드를 없애려는 목적만 남았던 다른 세계의 존재들이 엘리의 검에 베어: (Beings from other worlds, driven only by the desire to destroy Lerad, fall beneath Ellie's sword.)
strings.(그동안 엘리를 괴롭히던 적들의 움직임이 멈춘다. 그러더니 엘리의 눈앞에: (The enemies pressing Ellie suddenly stop. Then they vanish like smoke before her eyes, scattering into the sky.)
strings.(엘리가 조용히 하늘을 바라보던 중, 먼 하늘 어딘가에 걸려있는 무지개를: (As Ellie gazes quietly upward, she notices a rainbow hanging in the distant sky.)
strings.(마치 무지개를 타고 오는 것 같은 %s의 모습에 엘리의 눈시울이 붉어진: (Seeing %s approach as though riding the rainbow, Ellie's eyes redden.)
strings.(상기된 엘리가 천천히 %s에게 다가간다. 그리고 두 팔을 벌려 살며시: (Overcome with emotion, Ellie slowly approaches %s, opens her arms, and gently embraces them.)
strings.네 덕분에 불길했던 죽음의 안개도, 뜨거운 불의 강도 더는 다가오지 않아: Thanks to you, neither the ominous mist of death nor the blazing River of Fire is drawing closer. Vigrid has grown warm.
strings.이런 온기를 느껴본 게 언제였을까?: When did I last feel warmth like this?
strings.기억이 잘 나지는 않지만, 모두가 행복했던 그때의 엘리아스가, 아이들이: I can't quite remember. But Elias, when everyone was happy, felt like this. And Luminous, when the children could simply smile...
I was so happy, I couldn't help myself...
strings.혹시 오딘에게 주려던 거 있어? 잠깐, 내게 보여줄래?: Do you have something for Odin? Could you show me for a moment?
strings.(엘리가 수르트의 굳은 표정이 그려진 배지를 보자마자 폭소를 터뜨린다.): (The moment Ellie sees the badge bearing Surtr's stern face, she bursts into laughter.)
Hahahaha! This is too funny... Hah... hah... Pahahaha!
strings.(한참 동안 웃던 엘리가 눈가에 맺힌 눈물을 닦고 숨을 고르게 쉰다.): (After laughing for a long time, Ellie wipes the tears from her eyes and catches her breath.)
strings.하아…. 정말 재미있네. 무스펠헤임의 주인이 이런 식으로 자신을 증명할: Ah... That's wonderful. To think Muspelheim's ruler would prove herself this way.
It must hold tremendous power, despite its appearance.
Yes, I'm fine. The tension finally broke... Phew...
Shall we go? Odin and Nii will be waiting.
strings.(불어오는 바람에 레라드의 파란 잎이 춤을 추듯 움직인다. 그리고 그 아: (Lerad's blue leaves dance in the breeze. Beneath them, Odin and Nii hold hands and gaze at the rainbow.)
strings.(오딘과 니이가 레라드 쪽으로 다가오는 엘리와 모험가를 발견하고 미소짓는: (Spotting Ellie and the adventurer approaching Lerad, Odin and Nii smile.)
Well done, everyone... And I'm sorry... This is all my fault...
No, Odin. Something bad happened. That's all...
strings.오딘, 맞아. 나쁜 일이 일어난 거야. 그렇게 생각해. 우리가 살아가는: That's right, Odin. Something bad happened. Think of it that way. As long as we're alive, not everything will always be good.
And we can overcome it soon enough.
strings.그래요, 오딘. 그렇게 믿으세요. 지금까지 그렇게 믿어왔으니까, 앞으로도: Yes, Odin. Believe that. You've believed it all this time. Keep believing it.
Ellie always says the right thing.
Thank you too, Nii. Because of you, I entered Muspels Tunnel safely.
I'm glad. I'm not what I used to be, so I was a little worried.
You used to be lively enough to destroy the world.
strings.사실이잖아…. 아악, 니이! 때리지 마!: It's true... Ow, Nii! Don't hit me!
Sigh... Odin, Surtr asked me to give you this.
strings.(오딘이 헬과 수르트의 증표를 손에 쥐고 나서야 굳어있던 얼굴에 가볍게: (Only after taking both Hel's and Surtr's tokens does Odin's tense expression soften into a slight smile.)
strings.이걸로 당분간 비그리드엔 아무 일도 없겠지. 니플헤임도, 무스펠헤임도 다: This should keep Vigrid safe for a while. Niflheim and Muspelheim will be all right too.
And Ouroboros seems to have stopped moving...
strings.%s, 네 일이 모두 끝난 것 같다. 이곳에서 해야 하는 일이란 것들 모: %s, I think your work here is done. Everything you needed to do in this place...
As this world's chief god, I've found a way to restore your time and space.
You found it yourself, %s. I only helped...
strings.(니이가 파란색으로 빛나는 레라드의 잎을 엘리에게 건넨다.): (Nii hands Ellie one of Lerad's glowing blue leaves.)
What are you waiting for, Ellie? Take it before it withers...
They will help you return to the Front Side of the time and space centered on you. Farewell, %s...
There's no time, %s. The rainbow shining over this place won't last forever.
strings.그 존재를 만나게 되면 나중에라도 우리를 볼 수 있을 거야. 그러니까 지: Once you meet that person, you'll be able to see us again someday. For now, hurry.
Odin, Nii. Thank you. Take care...
I'll see you later too, Odin, Nii.
strings.(엘리가 오딘과 니이에게 인사하고 다시 왔던 길로 빠져나간다.): (Ellie says goodbye to Odin and Nii and heads back the way she came.)
strings.이렇게 빨리 만나게 될 줄은 몰랐어…. 그만큼 우리의 시간도, 세계의 시: I didn't think we'd meet again so soon... It means neither our time nor the world's has much left...
strings.(오딘의 입술에 니이가 검지 손가락을 올리며 장난스럽게 웃는다.): (Nii places a finger against Odin's lips and smiles playfully.)
Odin, you worry far too much.
strings.우리는 앞으로 지냈던 시간만큼, 다가올 시간도 잘 보내면 돼. 그게 당신: We only need to live the time ahead as well as the years behind us. That's why you and I are here.
strings.엘리가 일 끝내고 오면 우리도 돌아가자. 우리가 사랑하는 빛의 도시 루미: When Ellie finishes and returns, let's go home too. To our beloved city of light, Luminous...
strings.아무도 없는데, 누굴 만난다는 거죠?: There's no one here. Who are we meeting?
I'll call them now. Take my hand.
(Ellie slips Lerad's leaf between their clasped hands. As they slowly walk forward together, the surroundings begin to darken.)
Lerad's leaf has guided us to her.
strings.(엘리의 발걸음이 멈추자 뒤따라오던 %s도 멈춘다. 조용히 앞을 바라보자: (Ellie stops, and %s halts behind her. Looking ahead, they see a figure slowly emerge from the darkness.)
strings.(로브를 쓴 의문의 여성이 자신을 바라보는 엘리를 향해 작은 목소리로 인: (A mysterious robed woman greets Ellie in a quiet voice.)
strings.모험가와 함께 올 줄 몰랐는데…. 같이 온 걸 보니 드디어 때가 온 것: I didn't expect you to come with the adventurer... Since you're together, the time must finally have come.
strings.%s, 리리는 보이지 않는 곳에서 에트와르와 루미너스에 도움을 주고 있어: %s, Lili helps Etoile and Luminous from behind the scenes.
Ellie, as I've told you before, I'm not Lili. I've only borrowed her appearance...
But you're also Lili. Taking her form and doing her work...
If you must call me something, call me the mage.
strings.%s, 당신을 만난다면 고맙다는 이야기를 하고 싶었어요. 당신에겐 언제나: %s, I wanted to thank you when we met. I always feel I owe you an apology...
For protecting Iris, and for protecting Vigrid...
Lili... no, Mage. I feel like I've seen you before.
Yes. I know you. Perhaps you have seen me.
Since before you came to Belos...
strings.알고 있어요. 하지만, 이 방법을 쓰면 엘리에게도 영향이 갈 거예요. 오: I know. But this method will affect you as well, Ellie. Do Odin and Nii know that?
It's all right. I was prepared for it...
strings.리리가 지금 비그리드에 있는 너의 시간을 멈출 거야. 이면이 아닌 정면에: Lili will stop your time here in Vigrid. You will awaken on the Front Side, rather than the Reverse Side. There, you must find and resolve what needs to be done in that time.
strings.비그리드에서 니플헤임의 문을 막고, 무스펠헤임에 흐르는 강의 열기를 식힌: Just as you closed Niflheim's gate in Vigrid and cooled the river flowing through Muspelheim...
strings.당신은 눈을 감은 채로 가만히 있으면 돼요. 그러면 에트와르의 당신을 중: Simply close your eyes and remain still. You'll return to the moment before time and space split around you in Etoile.
strings.(모험가가 조용히 눈을 감자 곁에서 말을 걸어주던 엘리의 목소리마저 조금: (The adventurer quietly closes their eyes. Even Ellie's voice beside them gradually fades.)
%s, will you do me one favor? There's someone I'd like you to give my regards to.
To my beloved kingdom, Elias... and to my little sister, whom I love just as dearly...
strings.엘리, 동생이 어디에 있죠? 그런데 나의 왕국이요?: Ellie, where is your sister? And what do you mean, your kingdom?
strings.내 영혼이 아직도 잊지 않고 기억하고 있다고…. 그리고 나의 왕국이란 건: Tell her my soul still remembers and has never forgotten... And by my kingdom, I mean...
strings.(그 순간, 엘리가 멀어지는 느낌이 다가오면서 더는 목소리가 들려오지 않: (At that instant, Ellie seems to recede into the distance, and her voice can no longer be heard. The adventurer sinks into a deep sleep.)
